The problem

## Leads go cold in hours. Many teams take a day or more to call back.
A lead is most likely to talk to you in the first hour after they ask. By the time a busy team gets to them, they may have enquired elsewhere, stopped picking up unknown numbers, or bought.

- Your callers can't dial every lead within the hour, at 9 pm, or on a Sunday.
- Half the day goes on unanswered calls, voicemails and wrong numbers.
- Answers live in notebooks and memory, not in the CRM.
- Nobody has time to listen to calls, so nobody knows why leads are lost.

7×
more likely to qualify a lead when firms tried to contact it within an hour, versus an hour later

60×
more likely than companies that waited 24 hours or longer

42 h
average first response among companies that replied within 30 days

23%
of companies never responded to the lead at all

Source: Oldroyd, McElheran & Elkington, “The Short Life of Online Sales Leads” , Harvard Business Review, March 2011. The 42 hours and 23% come from the authors' audit of 2,241 U.S. companies; the 7× and 60× from their separate study of 1.25 million leads at 42 U.S. companies.

How it works

## From a new lead to a booked meeting, without anyone dialling.
Set it up once. After that, every lead that comes in gets a call, a conversation and a next step.

- 01

### Describe the job
Write a brief in plain words, or pick a template. Telleo drafts the script, the questions to ask and the outcomes to choose from.

- 02

### Pick a voice
Audition 80+ male and female voices in Hindi, English and Hinglish. The preview plays exactly what the caller will hear.

- 03

### Connect your leads
Meta and Google lead forms, your website, a CSV, or any system that can send a webhook. New leads trigger a call in about a minute.

- 04

### Telleo calls and acts
It talks, captures the answers, books the meeting or transfers the hot lead, then writes the outcome to your CRM and follows up.

### Your script, your outcomes, your rules.
Every agent is built from the same few fields: what it says first, what it must find out, the outcomes it can choose, who it hands over to, and how long it may talk. Telleo drafts the script, opening line, questions and outcomes from a short brief, scores the script against a rubric built from real call failures, and revises it from your feedback and the agent's recent calls.

Conversation quality

## Tuned on real Indian phone calls, not lab demos.
Telleo grew out of admissions calling, where parents interrupt, switch languages and say “haan” mid-sentence. Every rule below exists because a real call went wrong without it.

Hear the voices Test it yourself

### It lets people say “haan”
A “haan”, “achha” or “okay” while the agent is talking doesn't derail it. It carries on, and the yes still counts.
Caller: “haan…” → agent keeps going

### It never parrots answers back
No “Okay, so you scored ninety-four.” It moves to the next question. Phone numbers and booked times are read back once, on purpose.
“बहुत बढ़िया score है, अब…”

### It never repeats itself
A sentence already said in the call is not said again, so callers never hear the same pitch twice.
Same line twice → blocked

### Hindi grammar that fits the voice
A female voice says “कर रही हूँ”, a male voice “कर रहा हूँ”. Unsure of the caller's gender? It says “Rahul जी”, never a guess.
मैं आपकी मदद कर रही हूँ

### Everyday phone Hindi
“Enquiry”, not “पूछताछ”. It speaks the Hinglish your customers speak, not a textbook.
आपका demo confirm हो गया

### It sounds like a phone line
Telephone-band voice shaping and a faint room tone, so it sounds like a calling desk, not a studio recording.
Sounds like a calling desk

### It turns “kal shaam” into a booking
When a caller agrees a day and time in their own words, the analysis resolves it to an exact date and time and books it on your booking page.
कल शाम 6 बजे → Sat, 6:00 pm, booked

### It knows when to stop
If it can't hear the caller twice, it closes politely instead of apologising in a loop. It won't hang up on someone who speaks after goodbye.
No loops, no rude hang-ups

After the call

## Every call ends with a next step, not a note.
When the caller hangs up, Telleo reads the whole conversation and picks the outcome from your own list, with a summary, a lead score from 1 to 10 and the answers it heard. Then your rules run.

- Hot leads assigned to a rep, or transferred live while the caller is still on the line.
- Meetings booked on your booking page when a day and time were agreed.
- WhatsApp and email sent only when the caller said yes, tracked for delivery and never sent twice.
- Unanswered workflow calls retried after a gap you set; a “not interested” stops that lead's retries.
- A call where nobody really spoke is marked Incomplete, never Not interested.

See automations
Outcome rules
runs within a minute of hang-up

- Hot_Lead / Interested Assign to a rep now
- Meeting agreed Book it on your calendar
- "Send me details" WhatsApp or email the template
- "Call me kal shaam" Flag the callback for your team
- No answer Retry workflow calls after a gap
- Not interested / wrong person
- Stop retries for this lead
- Any outcome Fire a webhook to your systems

Use cases

## Nine jobs Telleo does on the phone every day.

All use cases
Lead qualification Ask every lead your qualifying questions, rate it 1 to 10 and send the ready ones to a rep. Instant lead callback Call every new lead from ads and forms in about a minute, while they still remember filling the form. Appointment booking Agree a day and time on the call, book it on your booking page and send the confirmation on WhatsApp. Payment reminders Remind customers about fees, EMIs, premiums and renewals, and note when each one plans to pay. Lead reactivation Call through old enquiry lists, find who is still interested and send them back to your reps. Feedback surveys Ask customers how it went, get a score and the reason behind it, and send unhappy ones to a person. AI receptionist Answer inbound calls through the Telleo IVR, handle common questions, capture the enquiry and transfer when needed. Event confirmation Confirm who is coming to your webinar, demo class or open house, and remind them before it starts. Application follow-up Call applicants who stopped halfway, find what is blocking them and send the link to finish.

Compare

## Telleo, a telecalling team, or an IVR?
The usual answer is Telleo plus a smaller, sharper human team. Here is the honest split.

| Telleo | Telecalling team | IVR / robocalls |

First call after a lead arrives | About 60 seconds, inside your calling hours | When someone is free | Instant, but one-way |
Holds a real conversation | Yes, with interruptions | Yes | No, press 1 / press 2 |
Hindi, English, Hinglish | All three, one language per agent | Depends on who you hire | Pre-recorded only |
Captures answers into the CRM | Every call, automatically | If they remember to | Keypad inputs only |
Books meetings and sends WhatsApp | On the call, automatically | Manually, later | No |
Every call transcribed and analysed | Yes, with a health verdict | Rarely reviewed | No |
Scales for a campaign spike | Same day | Hire and train | Yes |
Handles a complex negotiation | No, it transfers to your team | Yes | No |

Safe to switch on

## Guardrails first. Because it's calling your customers.

### Can't run away
Daily call caps, duplicate protection, a maximum call length per agent, and no dialling without balance.

### Admin-only diagnostics
Health verdicts and technical diagnostics are for your admins, and you choose which roles see full phone numbers.

### DLT done with you
We complete DLT registration with you and you choose the hours campaigns run. ₹5,900 a year at actuals.

### Humans stay in charge
Live transfer, a handover rule for every outcome, and nothing is sent that the caller didn't agree to.

We don't hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification today, and we won't claim we do. Read how we handle data .

## Questions buyers ask us first.

All guides

Will callers know they are talking to an AI? +
You decide how the agent introduces itself. We recommend saying it is an AI assistant for your business in the opening line. What callers do notice is that it answers their question, doesn't repeat itself and gets them to a person when they need one.

Which languages does Telleo speak? +
Hindi, English and Hinglish are live today, including callers who switch between them mid-sentence. The voice engines also support Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi and Odia; we set those up and test them with you before they go on real calls.

Do we need our own telephony, SIM cards or dialer? +
No. Calls run on Telleo's lines. If you want a dedicated caller ID, we can put the AI on its own line. Your human team can stay on Exotel or Airtel IQ for their calls.

What happens when a lead is ready to buy? +
You choose. The agent can transfer the call live to your team's numbers, book a meeting on your booking page, or mark the lead hot and assign it to a rep the moment the call ends.

Can we hear and check every call? +
Yes. Every AI call is transcribed (and recorded, with recording switched on for your line), gets a summary, an outcome and a lead score, and a green, amber or red health verdict that tells you if anything went wrong on the call.

How is Telleo priced? +
Per minute of conversation: ₹3.99 a minute on monthly plans from ₹3,499 a month, or ₹3.49 a minute with no minimum on the ₹19,999-a-year annual plan. Telephony, recordings and analysis of AI calls are included. Prices exclude GST; DLT registration is charged at actuals.

Does it work with our CRM? +
Telleo has its own CRM (included on the Annual plan, or ₹2,000 a month on Pro + CRM), so outcomes, owners and follow-ups land in one place. If you run another system, leads can come in by webhook or CSV and outcomes can go out by webhook.

Is AI calling allowed in India? +
Yes, within TRAI's rules. Commercial calling needs DLT registration, which we complete with you. Under TRAI's September 2026 amendment, once it comes into force (30 to 60 days after Gazette publication), AI voice calls count as application-to-person (A2P) calls that must be declared to the telecom operator, and an enquiry supports commercial calls for seven days; after that you need explicit consent. Read our TRAI and DLT guide and confirm your case with counsel.

What will the agent not do? +
It isn't built to negotiate complex deals or take card payments on the call, and your script should keep it from giving medical, legal or financial advice. Script it to hand those moments to your team. It can send a payment link on WhatsApp if the caller agrees.

Outbound

## Three ways to start a call.
Most teams use all three. The agent, script and outcome rules are the same whichever way the call starts.

- From a workflow. A new Meta, Google or website lead arrives and Telleo calls it in about 60 seconds. Or call after a missed payment, a form left half-done, or a demo tomorrow.
- As a campaign. Upload a list or pick a segment, and the agent works through it inside the hours you choose.
- With one click. A rep clicks “call with AI” on any lead to have the agent make the first call for them.

Inbound

## An AI receptionist that never puts callers on hold.
Route callers from the Telleo IVR to an AI agent. It answers the common questions from your script, captures who called and why, and transfers to a person when the question needs one.
Every inbound call gets the same analysis as an outbound one: an outcome, a summary and the answers captured.
The AI receptionist playbook

Inbound · IVR option 2 → AI agent Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent नमस्ते, Sunrise Academy में आपका स्वागत है। मैं आपकी क्या मदद कर सकती हूँ?Hello, welcome to Sunrise Academy. How can I help you?

- Caller NEET की weekend batch कब से start हो रही है?When does the NEET weekend batch start?

- AI agent नया weekend batch 12 October से शुरू हो रहा है। Admission के लिए counsellor से अभी बात करवा दूँ?The new weekend batch starts on 12 October. Shall I connect you to a counsellor now?

- Caller हाँ, करवा दीजिए।Yes, please.

- AI agent एक second, मैं आपको counsellor से जोड़ रही हूँ।One second, I'm connecting you to a counsellor.

Handover

## Your people take over at the right moment.
The agent qualifies. Your team closes. Every agent has handoff numbers and rules for when to use them.

- Live transfer while the caller is still on the line, after a short bridge line.
- Or assign the hot lead to a rep the moment the call ends, with the summary and answers attached.
- Meetings the caller agreed to are booked on your booking page automatically.
- Callback requests are flagged on the call, with the caller's own words in the transcript.

Guardrails

## Safe to leave running unattended.
An AI that calls your customers needs limits it can't talk its way past. These are built into every account.

- No balance, no dialling
Calls stop before a bill can run away. Top up and they resume.

Daily call cap
500 calls a day by default, set to whatever your team can follow up.

Duplicate protection
A lead can't be dialled twice by accident in the same 30 seconds.

-
- Skips assigned leads
Workflow calls leave alone leads that a rep already owns.

Maximum call length
6 minutes by default per agent, so a runaway call can't run up minutes.

Idle hang-up
If the line goes quiet, it nudges twice, then ends the call politely.

- Voicemail aware
A call where nobody really spoke is marked Incomplete, never Not interested.

Stops on no
Not interested or wrong person? Your rules stop automated retries to that lead.

## Frequently asked questions
How quickly does Telleo call a new lead? +
When a workflow starts the call as the lead arrives, the first call typically goes out in about a minute. Bulk campaigns work through a list at the pace your daily cap allows.

Can the agent answer our incoming calls? +
Yes. An option in the Telleo IVR can hand callers to an AI agent, which answers questions from its script, captures the enquiry and transfers to a person when needed. It works through an IVR on a Telleo number; it does not plug into an IVR you run with another provider.

How does live transfer work? +
Each agent has handoff numbers. When the caller asks for a person or your script says a lead is hot, the agent says a short bridge line and the call is connected to your team, while the caller is still on the line.

What caller ID do leads see? +
Calls go out on Telleo's lines. If you want your own dedicated caller ID for AI calls, we can set up a separate AI line for your account.

How long can a call be? +
You set a maximum per agent. The default is 6 minutes, which is plenty for qualification and booking; longer consultative calls should go to your team.

Can we run AI calls and human calls side by side? +
Yes. Your team can keep calling on Exotel or Airtel IQ, or use Telleo's click-to-call on the Pro plan. The AI and your people share the same leads, outcomes and history.

## Everything an agent needs, on one screen.
Opening line
The first sentence the caller hears. Who you are, why you're calling, and a question. It can use the lead's name and form answers.

Persona and script
Who the agent is, what it may and may not say, the facts it can use (fees, timings, locations) and how to handle objections.

Questions to answer
What every call must find out: budget, timeline, class, location. The answers are saved with the call, filed against your questions, and can feed your workflows.

Outcomes
Your own closed list: Demo_Booked, Callback, Not_Interested, Hot_Lead. The agent picks one after every call.

Voice, pace, expressiveness
Any of 80+ voices, a speaking pace, and a modulation level from Off to Lively.

Handoff numbers
Where live transfers go when a caller asks for a person or a lead is hot.

-
- Max call length
A hard limit per call. Six minutes by default.

Booking page
Where agreed meetings get booked, so a 'yes' becomes a calendar entry.

AI-assisted scripting

## Draft it, score it, fix it, improve it from real calls.
Four tools sit next to the script editor. Each uses what we've learned from live Indian phone calls, not generic chatbot advice.

- Draft: write a two-line brief and get a complete script, questions and outcomes.
- Analyse: score an existing script against a live-call rubric and see what will go wrong on the phone.
- Improve: apply the suggestions you agree with, one click each.
- Feedback: paste what went wrong on real calls and get a revised script.

Script review

- Ask one question per turn. Turn 3 asks for class, board and budget together.
- Close on a concrete next step. The script ends with “we'll be in touch”. Offer a day and time.
- Answer questions before continuing. No instruction for fee questions. Add the fee range or a transfer rule.
- No lists read aloud. Batch timings are written as a bullet list. Rewrite as one sentence.

Templates

## Start from a playbook, not a blank page.
Pick a ready agent from the gallery, answer a few questions about your business, and it builds the rest: admissions calls, fee reminders, re-engagement, parent updates and more.
Templates are education-first today, because that's where Telleo started. The builder works the same for any industry; our team helps you set up the first agent.

Answer a few questions to build it

Answer a few questions to build it

Answer a few questions to build it

Rules on top of your script

## The phone manners every agent gets for free.
Your script says what to talk about. Telleo adds the rules that keep a phone call feeling natural, learned from calls that went wrong without them.

- Answer the caller's question before going back to the script.
- One question per turn, then stop and listen.
- If the caller sounds frustrated, drop the script and deal with it.
- Stay in the agent's language; switch only if the caller asks or keeps speaking another language.
- No bullet points or lists read aloud; numbers spoken as words.
- A phone number or booked time is read back once to confirm. Nothing else is echoed.
- Never address someone by a word that isn't a name.
- Greet for the actual time of day.

## Frequently asked questions
Do we need to know prompt writing? +
No. Describe the job in plain words and Telleo drafts the script, the questions and the outcomes. You edit it like a document. If you do write your own script, Telleo scores it and suggests fixes.

Can the agent use details from the lead's form? +
Yes. The agent knows the lead's name and any fields captured on the form, so it can say “you asked about the 2 BHK in Wakad” instead of a generic opener.

How do we test an agent before it calls customers? +
Preview the voice, then have the agent call your own phone. Every test call gets the same transcript, outcome and health verdict as a real one, so you can fix the script before launch.

Can we have different agents for different jobs? +
Yes. Most teams run several: one for new-lead qualification, one for reminders, one for inbound. Each has its own script, voice, outcomes and handover rules.

Can the script include our prices and policies? +
Yes, and it should. The agent is told not to invent facts and to say so when it doesn't have one, so put in exactly what it may say about fees, offers and timings, and tell it to transfer anything else.

What stops the agent from rambling? +
Every agent follows built-in rules on top of your script: one question at a time, answer the caller's question first, stop the script when the caller is frustrated, and never read lists aloud.

Automations & actions

# The call ends. The follow-up has already started.
Telleo reads every conversation, picks the outcome from your list and runs your rules: assign the hot lead, book the meeting, send the brochure on WhatsApp, retry the no-answer, stop the not-interested. Nobody has to remember anything.

Outcome rules
runs within a minute of hang-up

- Hot_Lead / Interested Assign to a rep now
- Meeting agreed Book it on your calendar
- "Send me details" WhatsApp or email the template
- "Call me kal shaam" Flag the callback for your team

End-of-call analysis

## Six things every call leaves behind.
One pass over the full transcript, constrained to your own outcome list. Two guards keep it honest: no conversation means Incomplete, and a meeting only counts if a real day and time were agreed.

Outcome | Picked from your own list, e.g. Demo_Booked |
Summary | Two or three sentences a rep can read in five seconds |
Lead score | 1 to 10, how warm the lead sounded |
Answers | Only what the caller actually said, filed against your questions |
Callback | Flagged when the caller asks to be called later; their words stay in the transcript |
Meeting | Only counted when a specific day and time were agreed |

Outcome rules

## Assign, retry or stop. Decided by you, once.

- Assign to a rep on the outcomes you pick, round-robin across your team.
- Retry unanswered workflow calls after a gap, up to the number of attempts you set.
- Stop on not interested or wrong person, so automated retries end there.
- When retries run out, hand the lead to a person or close it: your choice.
- If you add the matching lead statuses, the lead is marked AI qualified, not interested, no answer or retry pending.

Assign
Hot_Lead, Demo_Booked → rep

Retry
No answer → again in 2 h, max 3

Stamp
Lead status: AI qualified

Stop
Not_Interested → stop retries

Promises kept

## “I'll WhatsApp you the brochure.” And it does.
AI agents promise things on almost every call. Telleo makes sure the promise is kept: when the agent offers a brochure, a location or a payment link and the caller says yes, the approved template goes out, during the call or within a minute of it.
Only what the caller accepted is sent. Every message is tracked for delivery, and never sent twice.

Meetings

## A yes on the phone becomes a slot on the calendar.
Link an agent to a booking page. When the caller agrees a specific day and time, the meeting is booked automatically, with the time checked so a past slot is never booked. Your team sees it with the call summary attached.

Workflows

## Chain the call with everything else.
A Telleo workflow can wait for a lead, call it, message it and tell your other systems, in any order. The AI call is one step among five.

Where leads come in
Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lead ads, Google lead forms, any website form via webhook, CSV or Excel imports and manual entry. Round-robin assignment to reps and de-duplication by phone or email are built in.

## Frequently asked questions
How soon after the call do the actions run? +
Within about a minute of hang-up. The call is analysed once, the outcome is written to the lead, and your rules run straight after.

Will it send a WhatsApp the caller didn't agree to? +
No. The agent only sends what it offered and the caller accepted on the call, using WhatsApp templates you have had approved. Each send is tracked for delivery and never sent twice.

Does it call back at the time the caller asked for? +
Not automatically. The call is marked as a callback request, with what the caller said in the transcript, so your team can follow up, or you can assign Callback outcomes to a rep. Calls started by a workflow are retried after the gap you set.

What if the caller never really spoke? +
Then the call is marked Incomplete, not Not interested. Workflow calls are retried after your gap; a campaign doesn't re-dial, so re-run it over those leads. Voicemails and silent pickups never close a lead by mistake.

Can outcomes go to our other systems? +
Yes. Workflows can call any URL with an HTTP request or webhook, so outcomes can reach your own CRM, sheet or ERP. There are no native Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho apps yet.

Where do leads come from? +
Meta lead ads, Google lead forms, any website form via webhook, CSV or Excel imports, and manual entry. Leads can be assigned round-robin to reps and de-duplicated by phone or email.

## Frequently asked questions
What does call intelligence cost? +
It is included at no extra charge on AI calls that are recorded and at least 20 seconds long. For your team's human calls it is billed per minute of recording analysed, and only when the analysis succeeds.

Which calls can it analyse? +
Telleo AI calls, your team's click-to-call calls on Telleo, Exotel or Airtel IQ, and recordings of calls made anywhere else, which you can upload against the lead.

Does it understand Hindi and Hinglish? +
Yes. Calls are transcribed in Hindi, English or a mix, including callers who switch languages mid-sentence, and the analysis reads the whole conversation.

Can we change what reps are scored on? +
Yes. The default rubric is rapport, needs discovery, objection handling and next step secured. You can change the qualities and add a hint about what your calls are meant to achieve.

Who can see the analysis? +
In the team view, a sales head sees only their own reporting line. Per-call analysis and transcripts are not restricted per role, so give call-log access only to people who should read calls.

Does it identify who is speaking? +
It infers the rep and the lead from what is said; there is no separate voice-based speaker separation yet. For two-person sales calls this is usually clear.

# AI Call Quality Monitoring with Per-Call Health | Telleo

Call health & QA

# Every AI call gets a health check. Bad calls stand out.
Too often, a team learns about a bad AI call from an angry customer. Telleo grades every AI call green, amber or red with a plain reason, so you can open the three calls that matter instead of listening to three hundred.
Book a demo Talk to our AI: +91 80353 74489

Call log · today
healthy check problem

- Rahul Sharma · 2:41 Healthy call Demo_Booked
- Meena Iyer · 1:12 Healthy call Callback
- Unknown · 0:19 Probably an answering machine Incomplete
- Vikram Rao · 3:05 Long silence (4.1 s) mid-call Interested
- Sana Khan · 0:47 The agent could not hear the caller Incomplete
- Arjun Mehta · 2:10 Healthy call · transferred to rep Hot_Lead

What it catches

## Plain-language verdicts, not a wall of metrics.
The agent could not hear the caller
Speech was detected but nothing usable came through. Often a bad line or a very noisy room.

The agent never spoke
The caller spoke and the agent produced no audio. Rare, and always worth a look.

Voice synthesis stalled
The voice engine stopped mid-reply. The agent reconnects and repeats, and the call is flagged.

Long silence
A gap of 3.5 seconds or more during a real conversation, with what the agent was doing at the time.

Caller answers were discarded
Something the caller said never reached the conversation. The exact words are shown.

The agent kept restarting a reply
Two near-identical replies in a row (three turns it red): usually a script or interruption problem.

Probably an answering machine
An estimate only. It never changes the outcome on its own.

Transfer failed · slow responses
A handover that didn't connect, or replies that took too long, measured on the call.

Honest numbers

## If we couldn't measure it, we say so.
A quality dashboard that shows zero when it means “we don't know” is worse than no dashboard. On Telleo, a signal that wasn't measured on a call is shown as “not measured”.
When a caller's answer is lost, you see the exact words, not just a count. When there is a long silence, you see what the agent was doing at that moment.

## A 20-minute weekly QA routine.
What we recommend to every team running AI calls. It catches script problems early and keeps the agent sounding like you.

- 1 Scan for red and amber
Scan the call log's health dots and open the week's red calls first, then a sample of amber ones. Read the headline before you listen.

- 2 Read three healthy calls too
Pick three green calls at random. A healthy call can still have a weak script.

- 3 Check outcomes against transcripts
Did “Demo_Booked” really have a day and time? Did “Not_Interested” really say no?

- 4 Fix the script, not the symptom
Change the opening line, a question or an outcome, then use the feedback tool to revise and re-test on your own phone.

## Frequently asked questions
Is call health the same as call intelligence? +
No. Call intelligence is about the conversation: outcome, objections, sentiment. Call health is about the machinery: could the agent hear, did it speak on time, did anything go silent or get lost. You get both on every AI call.

What does ‘not measured’ mean? +
Some signals can't be measured on every call. When that happens, the panel says so instead of showing zero, so a clean-looking number is never a guess.

Can we hear the call? +
With recording switched on for your line, yes: play the recording next to the transcript and the timings. Every AI call has a full transcript either way.

Who can see transcripts? +
Health verdicts and technical diagnostics are shown to your account admins. Anyone with access to the call log can open transcripts; they are not restricted per role. Health verdicts and technical diagnostics are shown only to your account admins, and on the call log you choose which roles see full phone numbers., and on the call log you choose which roles see full phone numbers.

Can we export calls for our own QA? +
Yes. Search and filter the call log by outcome, date, team, counsellor and more, and export the results.

Hindi, done properly

## The details Indian callers notice in one sentence.

- Verbs match the voice: a female agent says “कर रही हूँ”, a male agent “कर रहा हूँ”.
- Honorifics match the caller. If the caller's gender isn't known, it says “Meena जी” instead of guessing.
- Plain phone words: “enquiry”, “performance”, “fees”, not literary Hindi nobody uses on a call.
- Numbers are spoken as words, phone numbers digit by digit, and times in the 12-hour clock.
- The greeting fits the time of day. No “good morning” at 7 pm.

Sounds like a phone call

## Tuned for an 8 kHz phone line, not a podcast.
Studio-quality AI voices sound wrong on a phone call: too crisp, too close, too quiet in the background. Telleo shapes the voice to the telephone band and adds a faint room tone, so the agent sounds like someone at a calling desk.
The live voice pipeline runs on servers in Mumbai, next to the Indian phone network.

The voice library

## 80+ voices across seven speech engines.
Pick by ear. Every voice can be auditioned with your own opening line before you save the agent, and the preview uses the same engine and settings as the live call.
80+
voices

7
engines

4
modulation levels

- Google Chirp3-HD
The default for new agents. Natural Hindi voices, picked by ear.

- Sarvam Bulbul
Indian-built voices with the widest Hindi palette.

- Smallest Lightning
Standard voice set for Hindi and English.

- Smallest Lightning Pro
Pro voice set for Hindi and English.

- Rumik
Preset male and female voices; audition on your script before choosing.

- Microsoft Edge voices
A handful of Hindi and Indian-English voices.

- Deepgram Aura-2
English voices with an American accent, for English-only calls.

Also per agent: speaking pace and a modulation level (Off, Subtle, Conversational, Lively) for how much the voice rises and falls.

## Frequently asked questions
How many voices are there? +
More than 80, male and female, across seven speech engines. You can audition any of them before you choose, and the preview uses the same engine, voice and pace the call will use (the phone-line shaping is added on the live call).

Can the agent switch languages mid-call? +
Callers often mix Hindi and English, and a Hinglish agent handles that naturally. Each agent has a main language; it stays in it rather than drifting, which keeps calls consistent.

Why write Hindi in Devanagari? +
Indian voice engines pronounce Hindi best when it is written in Devanagari, with English business words like demo, fees or booking kept in English. Romanised Hindi reads worse on the phone, so Telleo's scripts and replies follow that rule.

Can you clone our own voice? +
Not today. Choose from the voice library; we can help you pick one that fits your brand and your callers.

Will it pronounce our brand name correctly? +
Test it in the voice preview. If a name comes out wrong, we adjust how it is written in the script until it sounds right on the phone.

Do you support regional languages? +
The voice engines support Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi and Odia. We set these up with you and test them on real calls before you rely on them; Hindi, English and Hinglish are the languages in production today.

# How Telleo AI Calling Works, Step by Step | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/how-it-works/

- Home
- / How it works

How it works

# What happens between “new lead” and “meeting booked”.
Nine stages. Here is exactly what Telleo does on every call, so you know what to expect and where to look when you want to check.
Book a demo Talk to our AI: +91 80353 74489

-

## 1. Something starts the call
A new lead arrives from an ad or form, a workflow reaches its call step, a campaign reaches the next name on a list, or a rep clicks “call with AI”.

- Meta and Google lead forms, website webhooks, CSV imports
- Or inbound: a caller picks the AI option in the IVR

-

## 2. Checks before dialling
Before a number is dialled, Telleo confirms there is balance on the account, the daily cap isn't reached, the lead wasn't just called, and (for workflow calls) no rep already owns the lead.

- No balance, no dialling
- 30-second duplicate protection
- Daily cap, 500 by default

-

## 3. The call connects
Telleo dials on its own lines, or on your dedicated AI line. The agent greets the caller by name with its opening line, fitted to the time of day.

- Telephony included
- Recording, when switched on for your line

-

## 4. Listen
Speech recognition turns the caller's words into text as they talk. A turn-taking model decides when they have actually finished, so the agent doesn't jump in on a pause, or leave dead air.

- Interruptions stop the agent mid-sentence
- “haan”, “achha”, “okay” don't derail it

-

## 5. Think
A language model decides the next thing to say, using your script, the lead's details and everything said so far. Rules in code stop it repeating itself or echoing the caller's answers.

- One question at a time
- Answers the caller's question first

-

## 6. Speak
The reply is spoken in the voice you chose, shaped for a phone line. The live voice pipeline runs on servers in Mumbai, next to the Indian phone network.

- 80+ voices, 7 speech engines
- Hindi, English, Hinglish

-

## 7. Decide and hand over
When the goal is reached the agent closes concretely: a day and time, a WhatsApp on its way, or a live transfer to your team. It ends the call politely and waits a moment in case the caller says something else.

- Live transfer to handoff numbers
- Maximum call length per agent

-

## 8. Analyse
The transcript is read once more to pick the outcome from your list, write a summary, score the lead from 1 to 10 and file the answers against your questions.

- No conversation → Incomplete
- Meetings only with a real day and time

-

## 9. Act, bill and grade
Your rules run: assign, book, send, retry or stop. The minutes are billed, the call gets its health verdict, and everything appears on the lead and in the call log.

- Billed per minute, rounded up
- Green, amber or red health verdict

## Frequently asked questions
How long does it take the agent to reply? +
Speed is a design goal: the live voice pipeline runs on servers in Mumbai, next to the Indian phone network, to keep the round trip short, and slow replies are flagged. Every call's timings are measured and shown in its health panel, so you can check for yourself.

What if the caller interrupts? +
The agent stops talking and listens. Short acknowledgements like “haan” or “okay” are treated as the caller following along, so the agent carries on instead of restarting.

What if the line is bad and it can't hear? +
It asks once in natural words. If it still can't hear, it closes politely rather than apologising in a loop, and the call is flagged in call health.

What if the call reaches voicemail? +
A call where nobody really spoke is marked Incomplete, not Not interested; workflow calls are retried, and a campaign can be re-run to call them again.

Does the analysis make things up? +
It is limited to your own outcome list and only records answers that were actually said. A meeting is only counted when a specific day and time were agreed on the call.

## What real volumes cost, with the arithmetic.
All figures exclude GST and DLT. The annual fee is spread over 12 months to compare with monthly plans.

### A small team trying AI calling
1,000 new leads a month · 55% answer · 2 minutes each = 1,100 minutes
Starter1,100 × ₹3.99 = ₹4,389/month (above the ₹3,499 minimum)
Annual1,100 × ₹3.49 = ₹3,839 + ₹19,999/year (≈ ₹1,667/month) = ≈ ₹5,506/month
Starter is cheaper here if you don't need the CRM. Pick Annual when you want the CRM and automations too.

### A growing sales or admissions desk
3,000 leads a month · 55% answer · 2 minutes each = 3,300 minutes
Pro1,750 × ₹3.99 + 1,550 × ₹3.49 = ₹12,392/month
Pro + CRM, monthly₹12,392 + ₹2,000 CRM = ₹14,392/month
Annual (CRM included)3,300 × ₹3.49 = ₹11,517 + ≈ ₹1,667 = ≈ ₹13,184/month
With the CRM, Annual saves about ₹1,200 a month over Pro + CRM, and has no monthly minimum.

### A seasonal business
8,000 minutes a month for 4 peak months, almost nothing for the other 8
Pro + CRM, all year4 × ₹30,795 + 8 × ₹8,999 minimum = ₹1,95,172/year
Annual32,000 × ₹3.49 = ₹1,11,680 + ₹19,999 = ₹1,31,679/year
Annual saves about ₹63,500 a year because quiet months cost nothing in minutes.

## Pricing questions
How are minutes counted? +
Per minute of connected conversation, rounded up to the next minute. Calls that aren't answered don't use minutes. Workflow calls are retried after your gap; re-run a campaign to call its unanswered leads again.

What does the Starter minimum mean? +
Starter bills at least ₹3,499 a month, which covers about 875 minutes at ₹3.99. Use more and you pay for what you use; use less and the minimum applies. It's meant as an entry plan for up to three months.

When does ₹3.49 a minute apply? +
On the Annual plan, from the first minute. On monthly plans, for every minute beyond 1,750 in a month.

What else might we pay for? +
DLT registration, which Indian regulation requires for commercial calling (₹5,900 a year, at actuals); WhatsApp template messages, charged by Meta through your WhatsApp provider; analysis of your team's human calls, per minute of recording; and 18% GST.

Are prices inclusive of GST? +
No. All prices exclude 18% GST.

Do you offer volume pricing? +
Yes. For high volumes, multiple teams or a dedicated calling line, talk to us about Enterprise pricing.

How do we pay for calls? +
Calls draw on your account balance, and dialling stops if the balance runs out, so a bill can never run away. Top up to resume.

Use cases

# Nine calls your team shouldn't be making by hand.
Each of these is a repeatable phone job with a clear goal, a few questions and a next step. That is where an AI voice agent can be faster, more consistent and cheaper than calling by hand, while your team keeps the conversations that need judgment.
Book a demo Talk to our AI: +91 80353 74489

## Lead qualification
Ask every lead your qualifying questions, rate it 1 to 10 and send the ready ones to a rep.

- Requirement, in the lead's own words
- Who the product or course is for
- Budget range
See the playbook

## Instant lead callback
Call every new lead from ads and forms in about a minute, while they still remember filling the form.

- Confirmed interest: what they enquired about
- Purpose, such as own use or investment
- Timeline to buy or start
See the playbook

## Appointment booking
Agree a day and time on the call, book it on your booking page and send the confirmation on WhatsApp.

- Meeting type: demo, site visit or consultation
- Agreed day and time
- Preferred branch, location, or online vs in person
See the playbook

## Payment reminders
Remind customers about fees, EMIs, premiums and renewals, and note when each one plans to pay.

- Payment status: already paid, will pay, needs help
- Promise-to-pay date, as the customer said it
- Preferred payment mode (UPI, bank transfer, at the branch)
See the playbook

## Lead reactivation
Call through old enquiry lists, find who is still interested and send them back to your reps.

- Current status: still looking, bought elsewhere, later, not relevant
- New timeline to buy or start
- What has changed since the first enquiry (budget, requirement)
See the playbook

## Feedback surveys
Ask customers how it went, get a score and the reason behind it, and send unhappy ones to a person.

- Score (0 to 10, or your own scale)
- Main reason for the score, in the customer's words
- Specific complaint, if any (delivery, staff, product, billing)
See the playbook

## AI receptionist
Answer inbound calls through the Telleo IVR, handle common questions, capture the enquiry and transfer when needed.

- Caller's name
- What they called about
- Specific need: course, property, appointment, product
See the playbook

## Event confirmation
Confirm who is coming to your webinar, demo class or open house, and remind them before it starts.

- Attendance: confirmed, maybe, can't attend
- Number of people coming
- Mode (in person or online), where you offer both
See the playbook

## Application follow-up
Call applicants who stopped halfway, find what is blocking them and send the link to finish.

- What is pending: a step, a document or a KYC item
- Reason it is pending, in the applicant's words
- Expected completion date, as the applicant said it
See the playbook

# Compare Telleo: Telecallers, IVR, Ringg, Vomyra | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/compare/

Compare

# Honest comparisons, including when not to pick us.
Every comparison lists the cases where the other option is the better choice. Third-party facts come from the vendor's own public pages, with the date we checked them.
Book a demo Talk to our AI: +91 80353 74489

## Telleo vs an in-house telecalling team
Use Telleo for the first call to every new lead, reminders, retries and routine qualification, where speed and consistency matter most. Keep your telecallers for negotiation, complex questions and relationships, and let Telleo hand them qualified leads with a call summary. Many teams will want both, working together.
Read the comparison

## Telleo vs IVR menus and pre-recorded calls
If the message is the same for everyone and needs no reply, such as an alert or simple call routing, an IVR or recorded broadcast is the simpler tool. If you need something back, like interest, a preferred time or a booking, Telleo fits better because it understands spoken replies and turns them into CRM actions. On inbound, an IVR menu option on a Telleo number can hand the caller to a Telleo agent.
Read the comparison

## Telleo vs Ringg AI
Choose Ringg AI if you need many languages, channels beyond voice, developer APIs, published security certifications or on-prem deployment. Choose Telleo if you are a sales, admissions or service team calling in Hindi, English or Hinglish and want the CRM, follow-ups, human-call analysis and simple rupee per-minute pricing in one place, with an annual plan that has no monthly minimum.
Read the comparison

## Telleo vs Vomyra
Pick Vomyra if you make a lot of calls to Indian numbers and want a flat monthly price, or you need voice cloning, many languages, an API and MCP server, white-label resale or ready integrations with Zoho, HubSpot or Salesforce. Pick Telleo if your volume is modest or seasonal and you want to pay per minute with no monthly minimum, with lead capture, assignment, retries, bookings, human-call analysis and per-call health checks in the same tool.
Read the comparison

## Telleo vs building your own voice agent
Build your own if voice AI is part of your product, you have engineers to own it, and you need full control over models, data and integrations. Use Telleo if you want Hindi and Hinglish calls, telephony, a CRM that acts on outcomes and per-call health checks without building and maintaining them yourself, priced in rupees per minute.
Read the comparison

# Telleo FAQ: AI Calling Questions Answered | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/faq/

- Home
- / FAQ

FAQ

# Straight answers about AI calling with Telleo.
Thirty questions buyers ask us, grouped by topic. Can't find yours? Ask us .
Book a demo Talk to our AI: +91 80353 74489

- How the calls sound
- Setting up
- Calls, telephony and compliance
- After the call
- Pricing
- Data and limits

## How the calls sound
Does Telleo sound like a robot? +
It is built not to. Agents speak everyday phone Hindi, Indian English and Hinglish, handle interruptions, don't repeat themselves or echo your answers back, and are shaped to sound like a phone line rather than a studio. The quickest way to judge is to call our test line, +91 80353 74489.

Should the agent say it is an AI? +
We recommend it. You choose the opening line, and a short “I'm an AI assistant calling from…” sets the right expectation without hurting the call.

What happens if the caller interrupts? +
The agent stops and listens. Short acknowledgements such as “haan”, “achha” or “okay” are treated as the caller following along, so the agent carries on and the yes still counts.

Which languages does it speak? +
Hindi, English and Hinglish are live. Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi and Odia are supported by the voice engines and set up with you on request.

Can it handle callers who mix Hindi and English? +
Yes. That is the normal case on Indian calls, and a Hinglish agent is built for it.

How many voices can we choose from? +
More than 80 male and female voices across seven speech engines, with a preview that plays the same engine and voice the call will use.

## Setting up
How long does it take to go live? +
The agent itself can be drafted in a single session. What usually takes longer is outside the product: DLT registration for commercial calling and approval of any WhatsApp templates. We start those in parallel.

Do we need a developer? +
No. Agents are built in a no-code builder, and leads can come in from Meta or Google lead forms, CSV imports or your website without code. Webhooks are there if your developers want them.

Can we use our own script? +
Yes. Paste it in and Telleo scores it against what works on real calls and suggests fixes. Or write a short brief and let Telleo draft it.

Can we test before calling customers? +
Yes. Have the agent call your own phone as often as you like. Test calls get the same transcript, outcome and health verdict as real ones.

Can one account run several agents? +
Yes. Most teams run separate agents for qualification, reminders and inbound calls, each with its own script, voice and rules.

## Calls, telephony and compliance
Do we need our own phone lines or SIM cards? +
No. Telephony is included. A dedicated AI calling line with its own caller ID is available if you want one.

Can our human team keep using Exotel or Airtel IQ? +
Yes. Your people can stay on their current provider while the AI calls on Telleo's line. Their calls can still be analysed by call intelligence.

Can the agent transfer a call to a person? +
Yes. Each agent has handoff numbers, and it transfers live after a short bridge line when the caller asks or your script says the lead is hot.

Can it answer inbound calls? +
Yes, through an option in the Telleo IVR that hands callers to an AI agent. It works through an IVR on a Telleo number; it does not plug into an IVR you run with another provider.

Is AI calling legal in India? +
Yes, within TRAI's rules. Commercial calling needs DLT registration, which we complete with you. Under TRAI's September 2026 amendment, once it comes into force (30 to 60 days after Gazette publication), AI voice calls are application-to-person (A2P) calls that must be declared in advance to the telecom operator, and a customer's enquiry supports commercial calls for seven days from the enquiry; beyond that you need explicit, verifiable consent. You choose who is called and when. Confirm your specific case with counsel.

How many calls can it make? +
A daily cap protects every account, 500 calls a day by default, and can be raised to match what your team can follow up.

## After the call
What do we get after each call? +
An outcome from your own list, a short summary, a lead score from 1 to 10, the answers the caller gave, whether they asked for a callback, and any meeting agreed, all on the call record.

Can it book meetings? +
Yes. Link a booking page and meetings are booked automatically when the caller agrees a specific day and time.

Can it send WhatsApp messages? +
Yes, with WhatsApp templates you have had approved, and only when the caller accepted on the call. Sends are tracked for delivery and never duplicated.

Does it call back at the time the caller asked? +
Not automatically. The call is marked as a callback request, with what the caller said in the transcript, so your team can follow up. Calls started by a workflow are retried after the gap you set.

Does it work with our CRM? +
Telleo has its own CRM, included on the Annual plan or for ₹2,000 a month with Pro + CRM. For other systems, leads can come in by webhook or CSV, and outcomes can go out by webhook or HTTP request. There are no native Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho apps yet.

## Pricing
How much does it cost? +
₹3.99 a minute on monthly plans from ₹3,499 a month, or ₹3.49 a minute with no minimum on the ₹19,999-a-year annual plan, which includes the CRM. Prices exclude GST.

Do unanswered calls cost money? +
No. Minutes are billed on connected conversation, rounded up to the next minute. Unanswered workflow calls are retried after the gap you set; a bulk campaign doesn't re-dial, so re-run it to call them again.

Is call analysis extra? +
Not on AI calls; it's included. Analysing your team's human calls is billed per minute of recording.

Can costs run away? +
No. Calls draw on your balance and stop when it runs out, and daily caps and a maximum call length apply to every agent.

## Data and limits
Who can see transcripts and recordings? +
Transcripts, summaries and outcomes are visible to anyone on your team who can open the call log; they are not restricted per role. In the call-intelligence team view, a sales head sees only their own reporting line. Health verdicts and technical diagnostics are shown to your account admins, and on the call log you choose which roles see full phone numbers.

Do you have SOC 2 or ISO 27001? +
Not today, and we won't claim otherwise. Our security page explains how data is handled.

What won't the agent do? +
It can't take card payments on the call, and it isn't built to negotiate complex deals. There is no built-in block on medical, legal or financial advice, so script it to hand those moments to your team.

Who is behind Telleo? +
Telleo is built by Vidyayatan Technologies LLP, the team behind Vacademy. It started as the AI calling inside Vacademy's CRM for education institutes.

More detail: pricing , security , TRAI and DLT rules .

# Security, Privacy and Calling Compliance | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/security/

- Home
- / Security & compliance

Security & compliance

# How Telleo handles your calls, your leads and your customers.
A plain account of what we store, who can see it, where it runs and what we don't claim. If your security team has questions this page doesn't answer, send them to us.
Book a demo Talk to our AI: +91 80353 74489

## What we store
For each call: the transcript, the analysis (outcome, summary, score, answers), timings and call-health diagnostics, and the recording when recording is switched on for your line. For each lead: the fields you capture in the CRM.

## Who can see it
Transcripts, summaries and outcomes are visible to team members who can open the call log, and are not restricted per role; health verdicts and technical diagnostics are for your admins, and you choose which roles see full phone numbers. A sales head sees their own reporting line in the team view.

## Where it runs
The live voice pipeline runs on servers in Mumbai. The platform that stores your CRM data and call records is not hosted only in India. If data residency in India is a requirement for you, tell us before you start.

## Who processes it
Like every voice AI product, Telleo relies on specialist providers: telephony (Plivo), speech recognition, language models and voice engines (for example Google Cloud and Sarvam). Audio and text pass through them to run the call and the analysis.

## In transit
Calls are streamed to the voice pipeline over encrypted connections, and each call's audio stream is opened with a single-use token, so a stream link can't be reused.

## Your data
Your leads and call records belong to you. To ask for an export or deletion, write to us and we'll tell you what's possible and how long it takes.

Calling responsibly

## An AI that calls your customers needs rules it can't skip.
DLT registration
Commercial calling in India requires DLT registration. We complete it with you; it is charged at actuals, ₹5,900 a year.

Who and when
You decide which leads are called and the hours campaigns run. Your outcome rules stop automated retries to not-interested leads; leave them out of bulk campaigns and manual calls too.

Built-in limits
Daily call caps, 30-second duplicate protection, a maximum call length per agent and no dialling without balance.

Honest agents
We recommend that every agent says it is an AI assistant in its opening line, and that its script steers away from advice only a licensed person should give.

Once it comes into force (30 days after Gazette publication; the A2P provisions after 60 days), TRAI's September 2026 amendment to the commercial-communication rules treats AI voice calls as application-to-person (A2P) calls that must be declared in advance to the telecom operator, and limits calls based on a customer's enquiry to seven days from that enquiry. Talk to us about how this applies to your campaigns. Read our guide to TRAI and DLT rules and confirm your specific case with your telecom provider or counsel.

What we don't claim

- We do not hold SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA certification today.
- We do not claim that all your data stays in India; only the live voice pipeline runs in Mumbai.
- We do not guarantee regulatory compliance on your behalf. You decide who is called, when and with what consent.
Questions from your security or legal team: hello@telleo.ai . Privacy policy: vacademy.io/privacy-policy .

# About Telleo | Telleo

About

# Telleo started on the admissions desk.
Telleo is built by Vidyayatan Technologies LLP, the team behind Vacademy, a platform education institutes use to run courses, tests, live classes and admissions. Telleo began as the AI calling inside Vacademy's CRM and is now its own product for every business that lives on the phone.
Book a demo Talk to our AI: +91 80353 74489

## Why we built it
Institutes buy leads from ads and portals, and research reported in Harvard Business Review found that firms which tried to reach a web lead within an hour were nearly seven times as likely to qualify it as those that tried an hour later. Counsellors can't call every enquiry within minutes, late in the evening and on Sundays, in the language the parent prefers. So we built an agent that could.
Admissions calls turned out to be a hard school. Parents interrupt, switch between Hindi and English mid-sentence, say “haan” while you're talking, and hang up on anything that sounds like a robot. Every one of those moments became a rule in the product: how it handles interruptions, why it never repeats itself or echoes answers back, how it conjugates Hindi verbs for its own voice, how it reads a phone number.
The same problems exist in real estate, lending, insurance, healthcare and every other business where leads arrive faster than people can call them. Telleo is that agent, with the CRM, automations and call analysis around it.

Listen to real calls
Every rule in the agent exists because a real call went wrong without it. We judge changes on live phone calls, not demos.

Fix it in code, not in the prompt
When something must never happen, like repeating a sentence, we enforce it in the pipeline instead of hoping the model obeys.

Measure honestly
If we couldn't measure something on a call, the dashboard says “not measured”, never zero.

Say what we don't do
No invented case studies, no certifications we don't hold. If a competitor fits you better, our comparison pages say so.

# AI Lead Qualification Calls for Indian Businesses | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/use-cases/lead-qualification/

- Home
- / Use cases
- / Lead qualification
Use case

# Qualify every lead on a call before a rep picks up the phone
Your AI agent calls each lead, asks the questions your best rep would ask, one at a time, and rates the lead from 1 to 10. Leads that fit go to a rep with a summary. The rest are retried or stopped by the rules you set.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Lead qualification Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent नमस्ते Rahul जी, मैं Sunrise Academy की AI assistant Neha बोल रही हूँ। आपने NEET coaching के लिए enquiry की थी, क्या अभी दो मिनट बात हो सकती है?Hello Rahul ji, I'm Neha, the AI assistant at Sunrise Academy. You had enquired about NEET coaching. Can we talk for two minutes?

- Caller हाँ, बोलिए।Yes, go ahead.

- AI agent Coaching आपके लिए है या आपके बच्चे के लिए?Is the coaching for you or for your child?

- Caller बेटी के लिए, वो अभी eleventh में है।For my daughter, she is in Class 11 now.

- AI agent आप online batch देख रहे हैं या centre पर offline classes?Are you looking at the online batch or offline classes at the centre?

- Caller Offline, अगर Civil Lines वाले centre पर हो तो।Offline, if it's at the Civil Lines centre.

- AI agent जी, वहाँ weekday और weekend दोनों batch चलते हैं। सालाना fees के लिए आपने लगभग कितना budget सोचा है?Yes, both weekday and weekend batches run there. Roughly what budget have you planned for the yearly fees?

- Caller सवा लाख तक चल जाएगा।Up to one and a quarter lakh is fine.

- AI agent हमारे senior counsellor आपको batch और scholarship की details बता देंगे। क्या मैं अभी आपकी call उनसे connect कर दूँ?Our senior counsellor will give you the batch and scholarship details. Shall I connect your call to them now?

- Caller हाँ, कर दीजिए।Yes, please do.

## Reps spend their day on leads that were never going to buy
Most lead lists are mixed. Some people filled the form by mistake, some want a different product, some have no budget, and a few are ready to buy this week. Your reps can't tell which is which until they call, so they call everyone in the order the leads arrived.
By the time they reach the good leads, those leads have often spoken to someone else. And the answers from a hundred short calls sit in a rep's head or a notebook, not in your CRM.
Qualification is the same five or six questions every time. That is the part of the job a voice agent can do on every single lead, while writing down every answer.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### The call goes out
A workflow calls the lead as soon as it arrives, or you run a campaign over a list, or a rep clicks Call on a single lead.

- 2

### Opening line with context
The agent greets the lead by name and mentions what they enquired about, using the fields from their form.

- 3

### One question at a time
It asks the questions in your script one at a time: need, budget, timeline, location, who decides. Your extraction questions tell the post-call analysis what to pull out. It does not read the caller's answers back to them.

- 4

### Handles questions and interruptions
If the caller asks something, it answers from your script and moves to the next question. A quick 'haan' or 'okay' while it is talking does not throw it off.

- 5

### Hot lead? Transfer or book
If the caller wants to talk to someone now, the agent transfers the call live to your handoff number. Or it agrees a specific day and time for a meeting.

- 6

### Rated and routed
After the call, the lead gets a disposition from your list, a short summary, a 1 to 10 rating and the extracted answers. Your rules assign it to a rep, retry it or stop.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Requirement, in the lead's own words
- Who the product or course is for
- Budget range
- Timeline to decide or start
- Preferred location, branch or mode
- Lead rating from 1 to 10, with a 2 to 3 sentence summary
- Meeting day and time if agreed, or a callback request

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

The lead fits (your Qualified disposition) | Assigned to a sales rep, round-robin if you use it, with the summary, rating and answers on the lead. The lead is marked AI qualified if that status exists in your CRM. |
The caller wants to talk to someone now | Live transfer to your handoff number. The agent says a short bridge line and connects the call. |
Not interested or not a fit | The outcome is saved as not interested and automated retries stop. |
The caller says 'call me tomorrow evening' | Saved as a callback request, with their words in the transcript, and the lead goes on your retry path. |
No answer, or nobody really spoke | Marked no answer or Incomplete, never Not interested. Workflow calls are retried after the gap you set, up to your maximum attempts, then handed to a human or stopped; a campaign doesn't re-dial, so re-run it over the leads who didn't answer. |

## Set it up

- Write the opening line and persona, or describe your business in plain words and let the AI draft the script. Score it against the live-call rubric before going live.
- Add your extraction questions: the five or six things every call must find out.
- Define dispositions (Qualified, Not interested, Callback, Wrong number) and pick which ones assign to a rep and which ones stop.
- Choose language, voice and pace, and play the voice preview to hear exactly what callers will hear.
- Add handoff numbers for live transfer, and set the retry gap and maximum attempts.
- Connect your lead source (Meta, Google lead forms, a website webhook or a CSV) and switch on the workflow. DLT registration is done with you before calls start.

## What to measure

- Connect rate: calls where the lead spoke ÷ calls dialled
- Qualification rate: calls marked Qualified ÷ connected calls
- Rep agreement: AI-qualified leads your reps also rate as good after their first call
- Meetings booked from AI-qualified leads vs leads your reps qualified themselves
- Average lead rating by source: Meta, Google, website form, import

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Real estate Call property leads fast, qualify budget and location, and book site visits. Lending Qualify loan leads, follow up on unfinished applications and make courteous EMI reminders. Insurance Qualify leads, remind before renewals and chase pending documents. Advice stays with your team. Automotive Test-drive booking, service reminders and follow-up on enquiries and quotes. Travel & hospitality Qualify holiday enquiries, confirm bookings and collect guest feedback.

## Questions about lead qualification
How is the 1 to 10 lead rating decided? +
After the call, the transcript is analysed against your dispositions and extraction questions, and the rating reflects how interested the caller was. The rating comes with a 2 to 3 sentence summary, so a rep can see why one lead scored 8 and another 4. Routing runs on your dispositions, not on the number, so you decide who reaches a rep.

Will it fill in answers the caller didn't give? +
No. Extracted answers are only what was actually said on the call. If the caller skipped the budget question, the budget field stays empty instead of being guessed.

Can it hand a hot lead to a rep during the call? +
Yes. Add handoff numbers to the agent. When the caller wants to talk to a person now, the agent says a short bridge line and connects the call live.

Which CRM do the results go to? +
The call, transcript, recording (when switched on), rating and answers are saved on the call, linked to the lead in Telleo's CRM. To send results to another system, add a webhook or HTTP request step to the workflow. It works with anything that can send or receive a webhook.

Which languages can it qualify leads in? +
Hindi, English and Hinglish are in production. Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi and Odia are supported by the voice engines and are set up with you on request.

Can I hear it before my leads do? +
Yes. Call the live test line on +91 80353 74489 to talk to an AI agent. In the builder, the voice preview plays the exact voice and engine your agent will use on real calls.

Use case

# Call every new lead within about a minute of the form
When a lead arrives from a Meta ad, a Google lead form or your website, a Telleo workflow calls them in about 60 seconds. The AI agent confirms what they wanted, asks your key questions and moves the good ones to a rep, a meeting or a WhatsApp.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Instant lead callback Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent नमस्ते Priya जी, मैं Greenfield Realty से Arjun बोल रहा हूँ। आपने अभी Facebook पर Sector 150 वाले 2BHK project के लिए form भरा था। क्या दो मिनट बात हो सकती है?Hello Priya ji, this is Arjun from Greenfield Realty. You just filled a form on Facebook for the 2BHK project in Sector 150. Can we talk for two minutes?

- Caller हाँ, इतनी जल्दी call आ गया! बोलिए।Oh, that was quick! Go ahead.

- AI agent आप flat खुद रहने के लिए देख रही हैं या investment के लिए?Are you looking at the flat to live in, or as an investment?

- Caller रहने के लिए। Possession कब तक मिलेगा?To live in. When will we get possession?

- AI agent Tower B का possession अगले साल March में planned है। आप कब तक shift होना चाहेंगी?Possession of Tower B is planned for March next year. By when would you like to move in?

- Caller अगले साल के बीच तक।By the middle of next year.

- AI agent Site visit के लिए इस Saturday या Sunday में से कौन सा दिन ठीक रहेगा?For a site visit, which day suits you, this Saturday or Sunday?

- Caller Sunday, सुबह ग्यारह बजे।Sunday, eleven in the morning.

- AI agent जी, Sunday सुबह ग्यारह बजे आपकी site visit book कर दी है। क्या मैं इसी number पर WhatsApp पर location भेज दूँ?Done, your site visit is booked for Sunday at eleven in the morning. Shall I send the location on WhatsApp to this number?

- Caller हाँ, भेज दीजिए।Yes, please send it.

## Leads go cold while they wait in a queue
Someone fills your form at 11:40 in the morning. Your team sees it after lunch, or the next day. By then the lead has filled two other forms and taken the first call that came.
Research reported in Harvard Business Review in 2011, covering 1.25 million leads at 42 U.S. companies, found that firms which tried to contact a lead within an hour were nearly 7 times as likely to qualify it as firms that tried an hour later, and more than 60 times as likely as firms that waited 24 hours or longer. Channels have changed since then. The idea has not: the first useful reply gets the lead's attention.
Keeping callers free for the lunch hour, the evening rush and the weekend ad spike is expensive. A workflow that dials the moment a lead lands does not need a shift roster.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### The lead lands
A new lead arrives from Meta (Facebook or Instagram) lead ads, a Google lead form, your website form via webhook, or manual entry. Duplicates are matched by phone or email.

- 2

### The workflow dials in about 60 seconds
The first workflow step is an AI call. It follows your time-window condition and daily call cap, and skips leads a rep has already been assigned.

- 3

### Context in the first line
The agent opens with the lead's name and what they asked about, so the caller knows why you are calling.

- 4

### Quick qualification
It asks the two or three questions that decide the next step, one at a time.

- 5

### Next step on the same call
A live transfer to a rep, a meeting booked on your booking page, or a WhatsApp with the brochure or location the caller agreed to receive.

- 6

### Retry if unanswered
No answer? The workflow retries after the gap you set, up to your maximum attempts, then hands the lead to a human or stops.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Confirmed interest: what they enquired about
- Purpose, such as own use or investment
- Timeline to buy or start
- Budget range
- Site visit, demo or meeting day and time, if agreed
- Consent to receive a WhatsApp (brochure, location, price sheet)

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

The caller agrees a specific day and time | The meeting is booked on your booking page automatically, and the WhatsApp the caller accepted (location, brochure) is sent and tracked for delivery. |
The caller wants to talk to a person now | Live transfer to the rep's handoff number during the call. |
Interested but busy right now | Saved as a callback request, with the time they gave ('kal shaam') in the transcript, and put on your retry path. |
No answer or voicemail | Marked no answer or Incomplete, never Not interested. Retried after your gap, up to your maximum attempts, then handed to a human or stopped. |
Not interested, or the form was filled by mistake | The workflow stops and the outcome is saved as not interested. |

## Set it up

- Connect lead sources: Meta lead ads, Google lead forms, or your website form via webhook.
- Create the workflow: new lead arrives, then AI call. Add a time-window condition for the hours calls may go out.
- Write a short opening line that uses the lead's name and the form they filled, so the call makes sense in the first few seconds.
- Keep extraction questions to the two or three that decide the next step.
- Add your booking page, handoff numbers and approved WhatsApp templates (location, brochure).
- Set retries: the gap between attempts, the maximum attempts, and whether exhausted leads go to a human.

## What to measure

- Time to first call: lead created to first dial, by source
- Connect rate on the first attempt vs later attempts
- Share of new leads that reach a next step (visit, demo, meeting) on the first call
- Leads that arrived outside your calling window, and how soon they were called once it opened
- Cost per qualified lead by ad source, now that every lead gets a call

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Real estate Call property leads fast, qualify budget and location, and book site visits. Lending Qualify loan leads, follow up on unfinished applications and make courteous EMI reminders. Insurance Qualify leads, remind before renewals and chase pending documents. Advice stays with your team. Automotive Test-drive booking, service reminders and follow-up on enquiries and quotes. Travel & hospitality Qualify holiday enquiries, confirm bookings and collect guest feedback.

## Questions about instant lead callback
How fast is the first call, really? +
A workflow triggered by a new lead can place the call about 60 seconds after the lead arrives in Telleo. The real gap also depends on how quickly your ad platform or form delivers the lead, on your calling hours and daily cap, and on whether one of your bulk campaigns is still working through its list, because new-lead calls wait in the same queue.

What happens to leads that come in at night? +
Workflow calls respect your calling hours, 9 am to 9 pm unless you change them. A lead that arrives at night waits in the queue and is called automatically when the hours open.

Will a lead get two calls if they submit the form twice? +
Leads are de-duplicated by phone or email, and a 30-second duplicate guard stops the same lead being dialled twice by accident. The automation also skips leads already assigned to a rep.

Which lead sources can trigger the call? +
Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lead ads, Google lead forms, any website form via webhook, CSV or Excel imports and manual entry. Any other tool works if it can send a webhook.

Won't a call one minute after the form feel pushy? +
The person has just asked you for information, and the opening line says why you are calling. If they say they are busy, the agent makes one short offer of a specific time for the next step; if they still decline, it asks when to call back and ends the call, and the call is marked as a callback request with their words in the transcript, instead of pushing on with questions.

# AI Appointment Booking Calls for Demos and Site Visits | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/use-cases/appointment-booking/

- Home
- / Use cases
- / Appointment booking
Use case

# Book demos, site visits and consultations on the call
The AI agent offers slots, agrees a specific day and time with the caller, and the meeting lands on your booking page automatically. A WhatsApp confirmation goes out if the caller wants one, and you can run a reminder campaign the day before to check they are still coming.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Appointment booking Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent Good evening, Sharma ji. This is Meera, an AI assistant calling from Riverside Dental Clinic. You asked about a consultation for teeth aligners. Is this a good time to book it?

- Caller Yes, go ahead.

- AI agent Would a weekday or the weekend suit you better?

- Caller Saturday, ideally.

- AI agent This Saturday the doctor has slots at 10:30 in the morning and 4 in the afternoon. Which one works for you?

- Caller 4 pm is fine.

- AI agent Done, your consultation is booked for Saturday at 4 pm with Dr Mehta. Shall I send the clinic address and a confirmation on WhatsApp?

- Caller Yes, please.

- AI agent Is there anything you would like the doctor to know before your visit?

- Caller No, that's all. Thanks.

## Every booking takes three calls and a WhatsApp thread
Booking a visit by phone sounds simple. In practice it is a missed call, a callback, a 'let me check and tell you', and a WhatsApp thread to confirm. Each step is a chance for the lead to go quiet.
Then the day comes and nobody reminds them. Your counsellor or site manager waits, the slot is lost, and the rep who booked it never finds out why.
The work is repetitive: offer times, agree one, confirm, remind. A voice agent can do all of it and leave a clean record of every booking.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### Confirm interest
The agent opens with the caller's name and the reason for the call, and checks they still want the demo, visit or consultation.

- 2

### Offer times
It offers days and hours from your script, one question at a time, and understands answers like 'kal shaam' or 'Sunday morning'.

- 3

### Agree a specific slot
A meeting only counts when a specific day and time were agreed. 'Sometime next week' is not saved as a booking; the lead goes to a person or back on your retry path.

- 4

### Read it back once
The agent reads the booked day and time back once, so the caller can correct it.

- 5

### Book and confirm
After the call, the meeting is booked on your booking page and the WhatsApp or email confirmation the caller accepted is sent.

- 6

### Remind
Run a reminder campaign over the next day's bookings. The agent checks they are still coming and offers a new time if they are not.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Meeting type: demo, site visit or consultation
- Agreed day and time
- Preferred branch, location, or online vs in person
- Who will attend
- Reason for the visit or main question
- Consent to a WhatsApp or email confirmation

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

A specific day and time are agreed | Booked on your booking page automatically. The WhatsApp or email confirmation the caller accepted is sent and tracked for delivery. |
The caller wants a meeting but can't fix a time | Saved as a callback request, with any time they mentioned in the transcript, and the lead goes on your retry path. |
The caller wants to speak to the doctor, manager or counsellor first | Live transfer to the handoff number you set for this agent. |
Reminder call: the caller can't make it | Recorded with your disposition, such as Rescheduled or Cancelled, and assigned to a rep who updates the booking. |
No answer | Workflow calls are retried after your gap, up to your maximum attempts; a reminder campaign doesn't re-dial, so re-run it over those customers. Calls where nobody spoke are marked Incomplete, never Not interested. |

## Set it up

- Create or pick the booking page the agent books into.
- Put your available days, hours and slot rules in the script, so the agent only offers times you can keep.
- Add dispositions such as Booked, Callback, Not interested, Rescheduled and Cancelled.
- Get your confirmation and location WhatsApp templates approved and link them to the agent.
- Set handoff numbers for callers who want to speak to a person first.
- For reminders, run a campaign over the next day's bookings inside the calling window you choose.

## What to measure

- Booking rate: meetings booked ÷ connected calls
- Show-up rate: meetings attended ÷ meetings booked, from your own records
- Reschedule and cancel rate on reminder calls
- Time from a lead arriving to a meeting booked

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Real estate Call property leads fast, qualify budget and location, and book site visits. Healthcare Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls. Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls, scripted to pass medical questions to staff. Insurance Qualify leads, remind before renewals and chase pending documents. Advice stays with your team. Automotive Test-drive booking, service reminders and follow-up on enquiries and quotes.

## Questions about appointment booking
Does the agent see my live calendar? +
The agent offers times from your script. After the call, the agreed day and time are booked on your booking page. Keep the slot rules in the script in line with your real availability, so it only offers times you can keep.

What counts as a booking? +
Only a specific day and time that the caller agreed to. 'I will come next week' is not a booking, so nobody waits for a visitor who never fixed a time; the lead goes to a person or back on your retry path.

Can it send the address or joining link? +
Yes, as an approved WhatsApp template or an email, once the caller agrees to receive it. Every send is tracked for delivery and never sent twice.

How do reminder calls work? +
Set up a short reminder agent and run it as a campaign over the next day's bookings. It checks the caller is still coming and records the answer with your dispositions. Rescheduled or cancelled bookings go to a rep to update.

What if the caller wants to talk to the doctor or manager first? +
Add a handoff number to the agent. It says a short bridge line and transfers the call live. The call record shows whether the transfer went through.
