# AI Payment Reminder Calls for Fees, EMIs and Renewals | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/use-cases/payment-reminders/

- Home
- / Use cases
- / Payment reminders
Use case

# Payment reminder calls that stay polite and end with a date
The AI agent calls each customer before or on the due date, tells them what is due, asks when they plan to pay and sends your payment link on WhatsApp if they want it. Anyone with a problem is passed to your team.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Payment reminders Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent नमस्ते Sharma जी, मैं Northstar Finance की AI assistant Kavya बोल रही हूँ। आपके two-wheeler loan की अगली EMI के बारे में बात करनी थी, क्या अभी एक मिनट है?Hello Sharma ji, I'm Kavya, the AI assistant from Northstar Finance. I wanted to talk about the next EMI on your two-wheeler loan. Do you have a minute?

- Caller हाँ, बताइए।Yes, tell me.

- AI agent आपकी चार हज़ार दो सौ रुपये की EMI पाँच तारीख़ को due है। क्या आप उससे पहले payment कर पाएँगे?Your EMI of four thousand two hundred rupees is due on the fifth. Will you be able to pay before then?

- Caller इस बार salary सात तारीख़ को आएगी, तो सात को कर दूँगा।This time my salary comes on the seventh, so I'll pay on the seventh.

- AI agent ठीक है जी। क्या मैं WhatsApp पर payment link भेज दूँ, ताकि उस दिन आसानी रहे?All right. Shall I send the payment link on WhatsApp so it's easy on the day?

- Caller हाँ, भेज दीजिए।Yes, send it.

- AI agent क्या इस loan से जुड़ा कोई और सवाल है जिसमें मैं मदद कर सकूँ?Is there anything else about this loan I can help with?

- Caller नहीं, बस इतना ही। धन्यवाद।No, that's all. Thank you.

## Reminders are the calls nobody on your team wants to make
Every month someone sits with a due list and a phone. The calls are awkward, so they get pushed to the end of the day, made in a rush, or skipped for the customers who are hardest to talk to.
SMS and email reminders are easy to ignore. A call gets attention, but a pushy call damages a relationship you want to keep, whether that is a parent paying school fees or a customer on their fourth EMI.
Most reminders need the same four things: who you are, what is due, by when, and how to pay. The calls that need judgement are the ones where the customer has a problem, and those should reach a person quickly.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### Load the due list
Import a CSV or Excel of customers with the amount and due date, or send each due customer to a workflow by webhook.

- 2

### A clear, polite opening
The agent says who is calling and why, and states the amount and due date from the customer's record.

- 3

### Ask for a plan
It asks when they plan to pay. If they say they have already paid, it notes that and closes the call politely.

- 4

### Offer the payment link
If the customer wants it, the agent sends your approved WhatsApp template with the payment link, during the call or right after it.

- 5

### Problems go to a person
A dispute, a request for more time or a wrong amount gets your disposition and is assigned to your team, or transferred live.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Payment status: already paid, will pay, needs help
- Promise-to-pay date, as the customer said it
- Preferred payment mode (UPI, bank transfer, at the branch)
- Reason for any delay, in the customer's words
- Dispute or wrong-amount flag
- Consent to receive the payment link on WhatsApp

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

The customer gives a date to pay | The date is saved on the call record with the summary. The WhatsApp payment link goes out if they accepted it, and delivery is tracked. |
The customer says they have already paid | Marked with your Already paid disposition and assigned to accounts to check, instead of being called again. |
Dispute, wrong amount or a request for more time | Assigned to a person on your team with the summary, or transferred live if you set a handoff number. |
No answer | Retried after the gap you set, up to your maximum attempts. Calls where nobody spoke are marked Incomplete. |
The customer asks not to be called about this | Your Do not call disposition stops automated retries for that customer; it is not a do-not-call list, so remove them from future due lists. |

## Set it up

- Import your due list with the amount and due date as fields the agent can read, or send due customers to a workflow by webhook.
- Write a polite opening that names your business, the amount and the due date. Keep the persona calm and factual.
- Add extraction questions: payment status, promised date, payment mode, reason for delay.
- Get your payment-link WhatsApp template approved and link it to the agent.
- Set dispositions (Will pay, Already paid, Dispute, Needs help, Do not call) and route disputes to a person.
- Choose calling windows and a daily cap that suit your customers. DLT registration is done with you before calls start.

## What to measure

- Reach rate: customers spoken to ÷ customers on the due list
- Promise rate: calls that end with a pay date ÷ connected calls
- Promises kept: payments received by the promised date, from your own records
- Disputes raised per hundred calls, and time to resolve them
- Payment link delivery: WhatsApp templates sent vs delivered

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Real estate Call property leads fast, qualify budget and location, and book site visits. Lending Qualify loan leads, follow up on unfinished applications and make courteous EMI reminders. Insurance Qualify leads, remind before renewals and chase pending documents. Advice stays with your team.

## Questions about payment reminders
Can it collect payment on the call? +
No. The agent does not take card, UPI or bank details on the call. If the customer agrees, it sends your approved WhatsApp template with the payment link, or an email, and that send is tracked for delivery.

Is this a debt collection bot? +
No. It is built for reminders to customers you already have a relationship with: fees, EMIs, premiums, invoices and renewals. You write the persona and script, and we recommend keeping it to the facts: what is due, by when, and how to pay. Customers with a problem should go to a person.

Does the agent know each customer's amount and due date? +
Yes, if they are fields on the customer's record. The agent can use the name and any field from your import or form in what it says.

Can each customer get their own payment link? +
A single payment page link inside the template works for everyone. If each customer needs a unique link, confirm with us during setup how that link reaches the template.

What about customers who have already paid? +
The agent asks, notes it and closes politely. Use an Already paid disposition to send those customers to your accounts team for a check, and upload a fresh due list before each round so paid customers are not called.

When do the calls go out? +
Only inside the time windows you choose, and never beyond your daily call cap. Calls also stop if your balance runs out, so a bill can't run away.

# Re-engage the old leads your team stopped calling
Many businesses have a list of last season's enquiries that nobody followed up properly. The AI agent calls the people on it who have given consent you can show, finds out where each person stands now and sends the ones who are still interested to a rep.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Lead reactivation Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent नमस्ते Rahul जी, मैं Sunrise Motors से Anjali बोल रही हूँ। आपने कुछ महीने पहले हमारी SUV की test drive के लिए enquiry की थी, क्या अभी बात करने का सही time है?Hello Rahul ji, I'm Anjali from Sunrise Motors. A few months ago you enquired about a test drive of our SUV. Is this a good time to talk?

- Caller हाँ बोलिए, वैसे गाड़ी अभी ली नहीं है।Yes, go ahead. I haven't bought the car yet, actually.

- AI agent क्या आप अब भी नई गाड़ी लेने का सोच रहे हैं?Are you still thinking of buying a new car?

- Caller हाँ, दिवाली के आसपास लेनी है।Yes, I want to buy around Diwali.

- AI agent इस महीने इसका नया variant आया है, automatic के साथ। क्या आप इस weekend test drive लेना चाहेंगे?A new variant came out this month, with an automatic option. Would you like to take a test drive this weekend?

- Caller इस weekend नहीं हो पाएगा, अगले हफ़्ते देखते हैं।This weekend won't work, let's see next week.

- AI agent जी, कोई बात नहीं। क्या मैं नए variant का brochure और price list WhatsApp पर भेज दूँ?No problem. Shall I send the new variant's brochure and price list on WhatsApp?

- Caller हाँ, भेज दीजिए।Yes, send them.

- AI agent अगले हफ़्ते किस दिन हमारी team आपको call करे, ताकि test drive का time fix हो जाए?Which day next week should our team call you to fix a time for the test drive?

- Caller बुधवार शाम को कर लीजिए।Call on Wednesday evening.

## Old leads are paid for, then forgotten
You spent money on ads to get those enquiries. A few calls were made, some did not pick up, and then the next batch of leads arrived. The old list is still sitting in a spreadsheet.
Nobody wants to call a two-thousand-row list where most people will say no. So it never gets called, and the few who are ready to buy now go to whoever reaches them first.
Reactivation is a volume job with one simple question at its core: is this still relevant to you? That suits an agent that can work through the whole list in your calling hours and write down every answer.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### Import and clean the list
Upload the old leads as CSV or Excel. Duplicates are matched by phone or email. A bulk campaign does not skip leads a rep is already working, so leave those out of the selection.

- 2

### Remind them who you are
The agent opens with the lead's name and what they enquired about earlier, so the call makes sense straight away.

- 3

### Find where they stand
Still looking, bought elsewhere, later, or no longer relevant. One question at a time.

- 4

### Offer something current
A new batch, a new project, a new model. If they want details, it sends the WhatsApp template they agree to.

- 5

### Route and close
Interested leads go to a rep. 'Later' is saved with what they said about timing in the transcript. The rest are stopped so they are not called again by this campaign.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Current status: still looking, bought elsewhere, later, not relevant
- New timeline to buy or start
- What has changed since the first enquiry (budget, requirement)
- Callback request, if they asked for one
- Consent to receive a brochure or offer on WhatsApp
- Lead rating from 1 to 10

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

Still interested and ready to talk | Assigned to a rep with the summary and rating, or transferred live to your handoff number. |
Interested, but later | Saved with your Later disposition, with what they said about timing in the transcript. Set Later to assign, so a rep can call them back. |
Wants details | The WhatsApp template they agreed to (brochure, price list) is sent and tracked for delivery. |
Bought elsewhere or no longer relevant | The outcome is saved as not interested and automated retries stop; leave it out when you re-run the campaign. |
No answer | A bulk campaign does not re-dial by itself: unanswered calls show as No answer in the call log, so run the campaign again later over those leads. Old lists have more dead numbers, so keep re-runs few. |

## Set it up

- Import only the old leads who have given consent you can show (under TRAI's September 2026 amendment, once it takes effect, an enquiry alone covers calls for just seven days), and let de-duplication by phone or email run.
- Write an opening line that names the old enquiry, using the fields from the list.
- Add dispositions: Interested, Later, Bought elsewhere, Not relevant, Wrong number, Do not call. Set Interested and Later to assign, and the rest to stop.
- Link the approved WhatsApp templates for your current offer, brochure or price list.
- Run it as a bulk campaign inside your chosen time windows, with a daily cap your reps can keep up with.

## What to measure

- Reach rate on the old list: leads spoken to ÷ leads dialled
- Reactivation rate: leads marked interested ÷ leads spoken to
- Wrong-number and not-reachable share, to judge the list's quality
- Meetings and sales from reactivated leads, tracked in your CRM

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Real estate Call property leads fast, qualify budget and location, and book site visits. Lending Qualify loan leads, follow up on unfinished applications and make courteous EMI reminders. Insurance Qualify leads, remind before renewals and chase pending documents. Advice stays with your team. Automotive Test-drive booking, service reminders and follow-up on enquiries and quotes. Travel & hospitality Qualify holiday enquiries, confirm bookings and collect guest feedback.

## Questions about lead reactivation
How old can the leads be? +
Check consent first. Under TRAI's September 2026 amendment, once it takes effect, an enquiry supports commercial calls for only seven days from the date it was made, so older leads need explicit consent that you can show. For leads you may call, older lists have more wrong numbers and switched-off phones; keep campaign re-runs few and watch the wrong-number share after the first day.

Will it call people who are already with a rep? +
A bulk campaign will, if you select them: it calls the leads you pick whether or not a rep has them, so leave those out of the selection. A workflow's AI call skips leads already assigned to a rep. Duplicates are matched by phone or email.

How many calls go out in a day? +
The default daily cap is 500 calls and you can change it. Set it to what your reps can follow up, not to the most the system can dial.

What if someone asks never to be called again? +
Add a Do not call disposition and set it to stop. That ends automated retries for the lead, but it is not a do-not-call list: a later campaign or a one-click call can still dial the number, so remove it from future lists.

Can the agent offer a discount? +
It talks about the offers you describe in the script. Write them exactly, with dates and conditions, and tell it to send price questions it can't answer to a rep.

What does it cost to call an old list? +
Billing is per minute of call, rounded up. That is ₹3.99 a minute on the monthly plans (₹3.49 beyond 1,750 minutes in a month) or ₹3.49 flat on the annual plan, plus 18% GST. See the pricing page for plan minimums.

# AI Feedback and NPS Survey Calls for Indian Businesses | Telleo

Use case

# Feedback and NPS calls that capture the reason behind the score
A short call after a visit, delivery, class or service. The AI agent asks for a score, asks why, and saves both in the caller's own words. Unhappy customers are assigned to your team as soon as the call ends.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Feedback surveys Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent Hello Priya ji, this is Riya, an AI assistant from Greenleaf Home Store, calling about the sofa delivered on Tuesday. Do you have two minutes for some quick feedback?

- Caller Sure, go ahead.

- AI agent On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend us to a friend?

- Caller Maybe a 6.

- AI agent What is the main reason for that score?

- Caller The sofa is nice, but the delivery came two days late and nobody called to tell me.

- AI agent I'm sorry about that. Would you like someone from our delivery team to call you about it?

- Caller Yes, that would help. After 6 pm is best.

- AI agent Thank you, Priya ji. Is there anything else you would like us to do better?

- Caller No, that's it.

## Survey links get ignored and scores come without reasons
A survey link on WhatsApp or email gets a few replies, often from people who are either delighted or upset. Many of the people in between never open it.
When a manager calls customers personally, the answers are richer, but only a handful of calls get made each week and the notes are hard to compare.
A short, consistent call asks every customer the same questions in the same order and saves the answers side by side. An unhappy customer on the phone can also be passed to a person while it still matters.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### Call after the service
A workflow calls the customer after the visit, delivery or class, triggered by your system through a webhook. Or run a campaign over the week's list.

- 2

### Short, specific opening
The agent says who is calling, what the call is about, and that it will take two minutes.

- 3

### Score first
It asks for a 0 to 10 score, or whichever scale you use.

- 4

### Then the reason
It asks what drove the score, with one follow-up at most. Script it not to argue; it does not read the answer back.

- 5

### Route the unhappy ones
Low scores and complaints get your disposition and go to a person, with the summary and the reason.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Score (0 to 10, or your own scale)
- Main reason for the score, in the customer's words
- Specific complaint, if any (delivery, staff, product, billing)
- Whether they want a call back from your team
- Suggestion for improvement
- Whether they would buy or visit again

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

High score, no issues | Marked with your Promoter disposition and stopped. If you offer a review link and they say yes, that WhatsApp template is sent. |
Low score or a complaint | Assigned to a person on your team with the summary and the reason, so they call back knowing the problem. |
The customer asks for a call back | Saved as a callback request on the call record, with what they said ('after 6 pm') in the transcript. Set Callback to assign so a person calls back. |
No answer | Workflow calls are retried after your gap, up to your maximum attempts, then stopped; a weekly campaign doesn't re-dial, so re-run it over those customers. Calls where nobody spoke are marked Incomplete and carry no score. |

## Set it up

- Pick the scale (0 to 10 NPS, 1 to 5, or yes/no), put the score and reason questions in the script, and add them as extraction questions so the analysis saves the answers.
- Keep the script to three or four questions and about two minutes.
- Add dispositions such as Promoter, Passive, Detractor and Complaint. Set Promoter and Passive to stop, and assign Detractor and Complaint to a person.
- Trigger calls from a workflow after the service, or run a weekly campaign over a list.
- Choose a calm voice and pace, and check it with the voice preview.
- Optionally link an approved WhatsApp template with your review link for happy customers who agree to it.

## What to measure

- Response rate: completed surveys ÷ customers called
- Score distribution and NPS, by branch, product or team
- Top reasons behind low scores, from the captured answers
- Time from a low score to a call back from your team

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Healthcare Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls. Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls, scripted to pass medical questions to staff. E-commerce & D2C COD order confirmation, abandoned-cart callbacks, failed-delivery (NDR) calls and feedback. Automotive Test-drive booking, service reminders and follow-up on enquiries and quotes. Travel & hospitality Qualify holiday enquiries, confirm bookings and collect guest feedback.

## Questions about feedback surveys
Is a survey call better than a WhatsApp survey link? +
They do different jobs. A link is cheap and works for customers who reply. A call gets a score and a reason from people who would never open the link, and lets an unhappy customer ask for help there and then. You can use both, and call the people who ignored the link.

Will the agent argue with a customer who gives a low score? +
It shouldn't, and you control that in the script. We recommend a script that thanks the customer, asks for the reason, offers a call back from your team and moves on. The agent does not read the complaint back to them.

How are open answers stored? +
Extracted answers keep only what the caller actually said, next to the score, a short summary, the recording and the full transcript. You can search, filter and export the call log.

How long should a feedback call be? +
Two to three minutes is enough for a score, a reason and one follow-up. Each agent also has a maximum call length, six minutes by default, which you can change.

Can some customers get the survey in Hindi and others in English? +
Yes. Hindi, English and Hinglish are all in production. Make one agent per language and run each over its own list.

# An AI receptionist for the calls your front desk can't take
Callers ring your line, pick an option on the IVR and talk to the AI agent. It answers the common questions from your script, notes down the enquiry and transfers the call to a person when the caller needs one.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · AI receptionist Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent नमस्ते, Sunrise Academy में आपका स्वागत है। मैं यहाँ की AI assistant Neha बोल रही हूँ। बताइए, मैं आपकी क्या मदद कर सकती हूँ?Hello, welcome to Sunrise Academy. I'm Neha, the AI assistant here. How can I help you?

- Caller Class six के admission के बारे में पूछना था। अभी admission चल रहे हैं?I wanted to ask about Class 6 admission. Are admissions open now?

- AI agent जी, admissions अभी open हैं और entrance test हर शनिवार को होता है। बच्चे का नाम क्या है?Yes, admissions are open and the entrance test is held every Saturday. What is the child's name?

- Caller उसका नाम Aarav है।His name is Aarav.

- AI agent आप किस area में रहते हैं, ताकि मैं school bus के route के बारे में बता सकूँ?Which area do you live in, so I can tell you about the school bus route?

- Caller Shastri Nagar में। और fees कितनी है?Shastri Nagar. And what are the fees?

- AI agent जी, उस route पर bus आती है। Fees की पूरी details हमारे admission counsellor देंगे। क्या मैं अभी आपकी call उनसे connect कर दूँ?Yes, the bus covers that route. Our admission counsellor will give you the full fee details. Shall I connect your call to them now?

- Caller हाँ, कर दीजिए।Yes, please.

## Missed inbound calls are leads you already paid for
An inbound call is usually someone who saw an ad, a hoarding or a listing and wants an answer now. When the front desk is on another call, or at lunch, the phone rings out and the caller tries the next number.
Most of these calls ask the same things: fees, timings, location, availability, documents needed. Your staff answer them over and over, and still miss the calls that come in together.
An AI agent on the IVR takes those calls, answers the routine questions and records who called and what they wanted, so your team spends its time on the callers who need a person.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### The caller dials in
Your Telleo IVR plays its menu. The option you choose for enquiries hands the caller to the AI agent.

- 2

### Greet and listen
The agent greets the caller with a greeting that suits the time of day, and asks how it can help.

- 3

### Answer from your script
Fees, timings, location, availability, documents: whatever you put in the script. For anything outside it, the script tells the agent to offer a person.

- 4

### Capture the enquiry
It asks the questions in your script one at a time: name, what they need, preferred branch, a good time for a call back.

- 5

### Transfer when needed
If the caller wants a person, the agent says a short bridge line and transfers the call live to your handoff number.

- 6

### Leave a record
Every call is transcribed (and recorded, with recording on for your line), with a disposition, a summary and the captured answers.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Caller's name
- What they called about
- Specific need: course, property, appointment, product
- Preferred branch or area
- Best time for a call back
- Whether a transfer was attempted and whether it connected

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

Question answered, nothing more needed | The enquiry is saved with your disposition and a short summary on the call record. |
The caller wants a person | Live transfer to your handoff number, after a short bridge line. |
The transfer is not picked up | The enquiry, summary and transcript are already on the call record, so your team can call back. Keep handoff numbers staffed: the health report only flags a transfer that could not be set up, not one nobody answered. |
The caller asks for a call back | Saved as a callback request, with what they said in the transcript, and assigned to your team if Callback is on your assign list. Switch on inbound lead capture so callers who are not yet leads can be assigned too. |
The caller wants a visit or appointment | If a specific day and time are agreed, the meeting is booked on your booking page. |

## Set it up

- Set the agent's direction to inbound (or both) and write a greeting that names your business.
- Put your common answers in the script: fees, timings, address, documents, availability.
- Set up the IVR on your Telleo line and point the enquiry option at the AI agent.
- Add handoff numbers for transfers, and keep them staffed during the hours the IVR sends callers to the AI.
- Add extraction questions and dispositions for your enquiry types, and assign callbacks to a person.
- Add a booking page if callers should be able to book a visit or appointment.

## What to measure

- Calls handled by the AI agent ÷ calls routed to it by the IVR
- Transfer rate, and the share of transfers that connected
- Enquiries captured with a name and a need ÷ calls answered
- Time from a callback request to your team's call back
- Top questions callers ask, from the summaries, to improve the script

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Real estate Call property leads fast, qualify budget and location, and book site visits. Healthcare Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls. Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls, scripted to pass medical questions to staff. Automotive Test-drive booking, service reminders and follow-up on enquiries and quotes. Travel & hospitality Qualify holiday enquiries, confirm bookings and collect guest feedback.

## Questions about ai receptionist
Does it replace my IVR? +
It doesn't plug into your current IVR. The agent is reached through an IVR menu option on a Telleo number, and it can transfer the caller to a person when needed., and the agent can transfer the call to a person when needed.

Can it answer on my existing business number? +
The AI agent is reached through the IVR on Telleo's lines. How your current number connects to it depends on your present telephony, so we work that out with you during setup.

What if the caller asks something that isn't in the script? +
Put the questions you get most often in the script, and tell the agent to offer a person for anything else. Every call is transcribed and analysed, including the questions callers asked, so you can find the gaps and add answers.

Can it book appointments on inbound calls? +
Yes. Give the agent a booking page. When the caller agrees a specific day and time, the meeting is booked there after the call.

Are inbound calls recorded? +
Yes. Every call is transcribed, and recorded when recording is switched on for your line.

Which languages can callers use? +
Set the agent to Hindi, English or Hinglish, all in production. A Hinglish agent suits callers who mix the two, which is common on Indian phone calls. Other Indian languages are set up with you on request.

# AI Event and Webinar Confirmation Calls with Reminders | Telleo

Use case

# Confirm attendance for every webinar, demo class and open house
Registrations are easy to collect and hard to turn into attendance. The AI agent calls each registrant, confirms whether they are coming, sends the joining link or location on WhatsApp, and a reminder campaign calls again before the start.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Event confirmation Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent Good afternoon, Rahul ji. This is Karan, an AI assistant from Sunrise Institute of Management. You registered for our MBA open house this Saturday at 11 am. Will you be able to attend?

- Caller Yes, I'm planning to. Can my father come along?

- AI agent Of course, parents are welcome and there is a separate Q&A for them. Will you be coming by car?

- Caller Yes, we'll drive down.

- AI agent There is free parking at Gate 2. Shall I send you the campus location on WhatsApp?

- Caller Yes, please.

- AI agent Would you like a one-to-one with an admissions counsellor after the session?

- Caller Sure, around 1 pm if possible.

- AI agent Done, your counsellor meeting is booked for Saturday at 1 pm. Is there anything else you would like to know before Saturday?

- Caller No, that's all. Thank you.

## Registrations are not attendance
A form fill takes ten seconds. Showing up takes an evening. In between, people forget, lose the link, or never saved the date.
Teams send an email and a WhatsApp and hope for the best. Calling every registrant the day before is the job that gets dropped, because it falls on the same team that is running the event.
The calls are short and all alike: are you coming, here is the link, see you at 6. A voice agent can make every one of them and give you a confirmed headcount.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### Load registrants
Import the registration list, or let a workflow call each person when they register.

- 2

### Confirm the details
The agent names the event, the date and the time, and asks if they will attend.

- 3

### Answer the basics
Venue, parking, joining link, what to bring, who can attend: whatever is in your script.

- 4

### Send the link or location
If they want it, the WhatsApp template with the joining link or map location is sent during the call or right after it.

- 5

### Remind on the day
Run a short reminder campaign a few hours before the start for everyone who confirmed.

- 6

### Handle the no's
Can't attend? The agent offers the next session if your script has one, and records the outcome with your disposition.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- Attendance: confirmed, maybe, can't attend
- Number of people coming
- Mode (in person or online), where you offer both
- Questions they want answered at the event
- Consent to receive the link or location on WhatsApp
- Follow-up meeting day and time, if agreed

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

Confirmed | Marked Confirmed. The link or location template they accepted is sent and tracked for delivery. |
Agrees a follow-up meeting | Booked on your booking page when a specific day and time were agreed. |
Maybe, or not sure yet | Saved with your Maybe disposition. Set Maybe to assign so a person follows up, or include the Maybes in the day-of reminder campaign. |
Wants to talk to someone before deciding | Transferred live to your handoff number. |
No answer | Calls started from a workflow are retried after your gap, up to your maximum attempts; a campaign does not re-dial on its own, so run it again over the leads who didn't answer. Calls where nobody spoke are marked Incomplete. |

## Set it up

- Put the event name, date, time, venue or link, and answers to common questions in the script.
- Add dispositions: Confirmed, Maybe, Can't attend, Wants next session.
- Get the joining-link and location WhatsApp templates approved and link them to the agent.
- Import registrants, or trigger a call from the registration form by webhook.
- Run the day-before confirmation and the day-of reminder as campaigns inside your calling window.
- Add a booking page if you want the agent to set follow-up meetings.

## What to measure

- Confirmation rate: confirmed ÷ registrants reached
- Show-up rate: attendees ÷ confirmed, from your event records
- Link or location delivery: WhatsApp templates sent vs delivered
- Follow-up meetings booked from confirmation calls

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Real estate Call property leads fast, qualify budget and location, and book site visits. Healthcare Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls. Appointment booking, reminders, report-ready and follow-up calls, scripted to pass medical questions to staff. Travel & hospitality Qualify holiday enquiries, confirm bookings and collect guest feedback. Recruitment Candidate screening calls, interview scheduling and joining confirmations.

## Questions about event confirmation
Can it send the webinar link? +
Yes, as an approved WhatsApp template or an email, after the registrant says yes on the call. Each send is tracked for delivery and never sent twice.

Should the reminder be a call or a WhatsApp? +
Both have a place. A WhatsApp with the link is cheap and fine for most people. A short call the day before gets a clear yes or no, and reaches people who never saw the message.

How much does a confirmation call cost? +
Billing is per minute of call, rounded up, so keep the script short: confirm, send the link, answer one or two questions. Rates are on the pricing page.

Does it work for walk-in drives and open houses with a venue? +
Yes. Put the venue, timings, parking and what to bring in the script, and link a WhatsApp template with the map location.

Can it tell me how many people are coming? +
Each call gets a disposition from your list, such as Confirmed or Can't attend, and the number of people is in each call's extracted answers if you ask for it. Filter the call log by disposition and export it to count confirmations.

# AI Application Follow-up Calls for Documents and KYC | Telleo

Use case

# Follow up every incomplete application, document and KYC
Applicants start forms and stop. The AI agent calls each one, asks what is holding them up, sends the link to finish on WhatsApp and passes anyone who needs real help to your team.
Book a demo +91 80353 74489

Sample call · Application follow-up Telleo agent · transcript
- AI agent नमस्ते Priya जी, मैं Sunrise College की AI assistant Pooja बोल रही हूँ। आपका B.Com admission form लगभग पूरा है, बस documents upload होने बाकी हैं। क्या अभी एक मिनट बात हो सकती है?Hello Priya ji, I'm Pooja, the AI assistant at Sunrise College. Your B.Com admission form is almost complete, only the documents are still to be uploaded. Can we talk for a minute?

- Caller हाँ, बोलिए। Twelfth की marksheet अभी तक मिली नहीं है।Yes, go ahead. I haven't received my Class 12 marksheet yet.

- AI agent कोई बात नहीं जी, अभी आप online वाली marksheet upload कर सकती हैं। क्या बाकी documents आपके पास ready हैं?No problem, for now you can upload the online marksheet. Do you have the other documents ready?

- Caller Photo और ID तो है, पर upload वाला link कहीं खो गया।I have the photo and ID, but I lost the upload link.

- AI agent क्या मैं इसी number पर WhatsApp पर upload का link भेज दूँ?Shall I send the upload link on WhatsApp to this number?

- Caller हाँ, भेज दीजिए।Yes, please send it.

- AI agent आप documents कब तक upload कर पाएँगी?By when will you be able to upload the documents?

- Caller आज रात तक कर दूँगी।I'll do it by tonight.

- AI agent बहुत अच्छा। Fees या hostel के बारे में कोई सवाल हो तो क्या मैं आपकी बात counsellor से करवा दूँ?Great. If you have any questions about fees or the hostel, shall I connect you to a counsellor?

- Caller नहीं, अभी नहीं। Thank you।No, not now. Thank you.

## Half-done applications stall in silence
An applicant fills three steps of a five-step form, or uploads everything except one document, and then life gets in the way. Unless someone calls, the application just sits there.
Your team knows the list exists, but chasing it is slow. Each call starts with finding the file, then asking what is missing, then explaining the same upload steps again.
Most blockers are simple: a lost link, a document they did not have handy, a doubt about eligibility. A voice agent can find the blocker on every file and send only the real problems to a person.

On the call

## What the agent does, step by step

- 1

### Load pending applications
Import the list of incomplete applications with what is missing, or have your form system send each one to a workflow by webhook.

- 2

### Name what is pending
The agent greets the applicant by name and says which step or document is still pending, using fields from the list.

- 3

### Find the blocker
It asks what is holding them up, one question at a time: a missing document, a lost link, a doubt about eligibility or fees.

- 4

### Send the link
If they want it, the approved WhatsApp template with the form or upload link is sent during the call or right after it.

- 5

### Get a date or hand over
It asks when they expect to finish. Questions it cannot answer go to your team, by live transfer or assignment.

Into your CRM

## What it captures on every call

- What is pending: a step, a document or a KYC item
- Reason it is pending, in the applicant's words
- Expected completion date, as the applicant said it
- Documents they already have ready
- Questions about eligibility, fees or process
- Consent to receive the form or upload link on WhatsApp

After the call

## What happens next
When | Then |

The applicant wants the link | The approved WhatsApp template with the form or upload link is sent and tracked for delivery. |
Needs help from a person | Assigned to a counsellor or operations executive with the summary, or transferred live to your handoff number. |
Will finish later | Their expected date is on the call record. Run the next follow-up campaign over the applications that are still incomplete. |
No longer interested | The workflow stops and the outcome is saved as not interested, so your team can close the file. |
No answer | Calls from a workflow are retried after your gap, up to your maximum attempts, then handed to a person or stopped. A campaign does not re-dial on its own, so re-run it over the still-pending list. |

## Set it up

- Export pending applications with name, phone and what is missing, then import them, or send them to a workflow by webhook.
- Write the opening so it names the exact pending step or document, using fields from the list.
- Add extraction questions: the blocker, documents ready, expected completion date.
- Get your form and upload-link WhatsApp templates approved and link them to the agent.
- Add dispositions (Will complete, Needs help, Not interested, Wrong number) and route Needs help to a person.
- Re-run the campaign over the still-pending list every few days, inside your calling window.

## What to measure

- Completion rate: applications finished within 7 days of the call ÷ applicants reached
- Top blockers, from the captured reasons
- Link delivery: WhatsApp templates sent vs delivered
- Share of applicants who need a person, and the time taken to reach them

## Where teams use it most
Education Admission enquiries, demo classes, fee reminders and parent calls in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Lending Qualify loan leads, follow up on unfinished applications and make courteous EMI reminders. Insurance Qualify leads, remind before renewals and chase pending documents. Advice stays with your team. Recruitment Candidate screening calls, interview scheduling and joining confirmations.

## Questions about application follow-up
Can the agent collect documents or verify KYC on the call? +
No. It cannot receive documents or verify identity on a call. It finds out what is missing, sends the form or upload link on WhatsApp if the applicant agrees, and routes KYC questions to your team.

Will it ask for Aadhaar or PAN numbers? +
It shouldn't, and we recommend keeping ID numbers out of the script. Identity details belong in your secure upload flow, not in a call transcript. Transcripts are visible to anyone with call-log access, which is another reason to keep ID numbers out of calls.

How does the agent know what is pending for each applicant? +
Include it in the list you import or the webhook you send, as a field on the lead. The agent can use the applicant's name and any such field in what it says.

How often should we follow up? +
For unanswered calls, set the retry gap and maximum attempts. For applicants who answered but did not finish, re-run the campaign over the still-pending list every few days rather than calling daily.

Does it work with our application system? +
Yes, if your system can send or receive a webhook. Otherwise, export pending applications as CSV or Excel and import them.

The phone problem

## Where calls slip in education
01

### Enquiries arrive when counsellors are busy
Admission season brings enquiries in bursts: after an ad goes live, after results, on Sunday evenings. Counsellors call back hours or days later, by which time the family has spoken to other institutes.

02

### Counsellors spend the day on the wrong calls
Many enquiries are for another course, another city or a different budget. Each one still takes a counsellor's call to find that out.

03

### Fee and parent calls are the same call, again and again
Fee due dates, missed classes and parent updates are short, repetitive calls. They are the first work to slip when the team is stretched.

04

### Nobody remembers what was said
Notes live in registers and WhatsApp chats. When a parent calls back, the next counsellor starts from zero.

What Telleo does

## The calls your AI agents make

### Call every new enquiry
A form fill from Meta, Google or your website triggers a call within about a minute. The agent asks course, class, city and preferred batch, one question at a time.
Instant lead callback

### Qualify and hand over to counsellors
Enquiries that match your criteria are assigned to a counsellor with a summary, a 1 to 10 lead rating and the answers captured. The rest are marked and stopped.
Lead qualification

### Book demo classes and counselling sessions
When the family agrees a day and time, the agent books it on your booking page and sends a WhatsApp confirmation from your approved template.
Appointment booking

### Fee reminders to parents
Polite reminders before and after the due date, with the amount and date from your list. Parents who want to speak to accounts are transferred live.
Payment reminders

### Re-engage last season's enquiries
Enquiries that went cold, from families who have consented to hear from you, get a fresh call when a new batch or crash course opens. Interested families go straight to a counsellor.
Lead reactivation

### Parent feedback calls
Short calls after a parent-teacher meeting or at term end to hear what parents think. Every answer is saved on the call record.
Feedback surveys

Into your CRM

## Answers worth capturing

- Student's class or year
- Course or exam of interest
- City or preferred centre
- Preferred batch: weekday, weekend or online
- Who decides: student or parent
- Fee or scholarship questions raised
- Demo class or counselling day and time
- Callback request, if the family was busy

Day one

## A first rollout

- 1 Connect your enquiry sources
Link Meta lead ads and Google lead forms, point your website form at a webhook, or import last month's enquiries from a CSV or Excel file.

- 2 Start from the admissions template
Pick the admissions template from the use-case gallery. Add your courses, fees, batch timings and demo schedule, and set the questions every call must answer.

- 3 Set outcomes and handover
Choose which dispositions go to a counsellor and which stop, and how many times to retry an unanswered number. Add a counsellor's number for live transfer.

- 4 Test on your own phone, then go live
Call yourself and a colleague, score the script and apply the suggested fixes, then switch on the new-enquiry trigger inside your calling hours.

Be careful with

- The agent only knows what is in its script. Keep fees, batch dates and scholarship rules current, or it will quote old figures.
- Many enquiry forms are filled by students. Decide in the script when the agent should ask for a parent, especially before it discusses fees.
- DLT registration is required for commercial calling in India, and under TRAI's September 2026 amendment, once it takes effect, AI calls must also be declared to your telecom operator in advance. Telleo registers DLT with you, and you choose the hours calls go out.
- WhatsApp confirmations and brochures need approved WhatsApp templates before you go live.

## Education: common questions
Can the agent speak Hindi and English on the same call? +
Yes. Hindi, English and Hinglish are all in production. Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali and other regional languages are supported by the voice engines and are set up with you on request.

Will it replace my counsellors? +
No. It makes the first call, asks the qualifying questions and books the demo. Your counsellors take the families who are ready to talk about admission, with the call summary in front of them.

What happens if a parent wants to talk to a person? +
The agent can transfer the call live to a counsellor's number you set. If the parent would rather be called later, the call is marked as a callback request, with their words in the transcript. Add Callback to the outcomes that assign to a counsellor if you want those families handed to a person; otherwise workflow calls go back on your retry path.

Can it call students who enquired months ago? +
Only with consent. Under TRAI's September 2026 amendment, once it takes effect, an enquiry supports commercial calls for only seven days, so older enquiries need explicit consent you can show. For families who have consented, import the list as a CSV and run a campaign within your calling hours. A bulk campaign calls every lead you select, including families a counsellor is already working, so leave those out of the list. Only workflow calls skip leads already assigned to a counsellor.

Can Telleo also review my counsellors' own calls? +
Yes. Calls your team makes by click-to-call on Plivo, Exotel or Airtel, or recordings you upload, are transcribed and scored against your rubric. That is charged per minute of recording. Analysis of AI calls is free.

Does it work with the CRM we already use? +
Leads, calls and outcomes live in Telleo. To pass them to another system, add a webhook or HTTP request step. Anything that can send or receive a webhook can connect.

The phone problem

## Where calls slip in real estate
01

### Leads cool within hours
Research reported in Harvard Business Review in 2011, covering 1.25 million leads at 42 U.S. companies, found that firms which tried to reach a web lead within an hour were nearly 7 times as likely to qualify it as those that tried an hour later. Property enquiries from ads often arrive in the evening and on weekends, when the sales team is off.

02

### Many leads are only browsing
Budget, location and possession timeline decide whether a lead is worth a site visit. Finding that out takes a call, and sales teams spend whole days on leads who were only curious.

03

### Site visits get missed
A visit booked on Tuesday for Sunday is easy to forget. Without a reminder call the site team waits and the slot is wasted.

04

### Old enquiries sit unused
Every project builds up a long list of past enquiries. Nobody has time to call them when a new tower, price or offer launches.

What Telleo does

## The calls your AI agents make

### Call ad and website leads in about a minute
Meta and Google lead-form enquiries, and website forms sent by webhook, trigger a call within about a minute, weekends included, inside the hours you set.
Instant lead callback

### Qualify budget, location and timeline
The agent asks configuration, budget, preferred location, possession timeline and whether the home is for living in or investment. Each lead gets a 1 to 10 rating and a summary.
Lead qualification

### Book site visits
When the buyer agrees a day and time, the visit is booked on your booking page and confirmed on WhatsApp from your approved template.
Appointment booking

### Confirm visits the day before
A short call the day before checks the buyer is still coming and who is coming with them. A buyer who cannot make it can agree a new time on the same call.
Event confirmation

### Reactivate old enquiries
When a new phase, price or offer launches, run a campaign over past enquiries who have consented to hear from you, and pass the interested ones to sales.
Lead reactivation

### Transfer serious buyers live
A buyer who wants to talk price right now is connected to your sales manager mid-call, after the agent says a short bridge line.

Into your CRM

## Answers worth capturing

- Configuration: 1, 2 or 3 BHK, plot or commercial
- Budget range
- Preferred location or project
- Living in or investment
- Possession timeline
- Home loan needed or not

- Who else will join the visit

Day one

## A first rollout

- 1 Connect lead sources
Link Meta lead ads and Google lead forms. Microsites and portals that can post new leads to a webhook connect the same way; for the rest, import exports as CSV.

- 2 Write the project brief
Put projects, configurations, price bands, possession dates and site timings in the script. Draft it from a plain-language brief, then score it before you go live.

- 3 Decide who gets which lead
Route qualified buyers round-robin to your sales team, send visit bookings to the site team, and stop leads marked not interested.

- 4 Go live on new leads, then the backlog
Run fresh leads first and review the transcripts for a few days. Then run a campaign over past enquiries you have explicit consent to call.

Be careful with

- Keep prices and inventory in the script up to date. The agent quotes only what you give it, so an old price list means wrong answers.
- The agent should not promise discounts, returns on investment or approvals your sales team has not signed off. Leave commitments to people.
- Portal leads connect only if the portal can send a webhook or export a file. There is no built-in portal integration.
- DLT registration is required for commercial calling in India. Telleo registers it with you, and you choose the calling hours.

## Real estate: common questions
Can it call leads from property portals? +
If the portal can post new leads to a webhook, yes, in the same way as Meta and Google leads. If it only offers downloads, import the file as a CSV and run a campaign.

Can the agent share brochures or location links? +
Yes, on WhatsApp, using templates you have had approved. The agent offers to send, and the message goes only if the buyer says yes. Each send is tracked and never sent twice.

What if a buyer wants to negotiate on the call? +
Set a handoff number. The agent says a short bridge line and connects the buyer to your sales manager live. You can also make 'wants to negotiate' a disposition that assigns the lead to your sales team.

Will it call the same lead twice by mistake? +
Leads are de-duplicated by phone or email, a 30-second guard stops a number being dialled twice by accident, and workflow calls skip leads already assigned to a salesperson (a bulk campaign calls whoever you select), and workflow calls retry unanswered numbers with the gap and limit you set.

Do we need our own SIMs or dialer? +
No. Calls run on Telleo's lines. If you want buyers to see one consistent number, you can take a dedicated AI line with your own caller ID.

The phone problem

## Where calls slip in healthcare
01

### The front desk is also the phone line
Receptionists handle walk-ins, billing and calls at the same time. Outbound reminder and follow-up calls are the first to be dropped.

02

### Missed appointments waste doctor time
A no-show leaves a gap another patient could have used. A reminder call the day before gives the patient a chance to confirm or free the slot.

03

### Report and follow-up calls repeat all day
Telling patients their report is ready, or checking in after a procedure, is the same short call made many times a day.

04

### Enquiries wait until morning
Patients who fill a website or ad form in the evening often hear back only the next day, if at all.

What Telleo does

## The calls your AI agents make

### Book appointments from enquiries
Website and ad enquiries get a call within about a minute. The agent asks which department or doctor and a preferred day and time, then books it on your booking page.
Appointment booking

### Reminder calls before the visit
A call the day before confirms the patient is coming. A patient who cannot make it can agree a new time on the same call.
Event confirmation

### Report-ready calls
The agent tells the patient their report is ready and when they can collect it. Script it not to read out or explain results.

### Post-visit follow-up and feedback
A short call a few days after a visit or procedure collects feedback. Anyone who mentions a problem is flagged for your staff to call back.
Feedback surveys

### Take bookings from the Telleo IVR
Callers who pick the appointment option on an IVR menu set up on your Telleo number can be handed to the agent. Anything else is transferred to the desk.
AI receptionist

For labs: which package, home collection or walk-in, and a preferred slot. Ready enquiries go to your team with the answers filled in.
Lead qualification

Day one

## A first rollout

- 1 Start with reminders
Upload tomorrow's appointment list as a CSV and run a reminder campaign inside clinic hours. It is the simplest call to get right first.

- 2 Write the boundaries into the script
List what the agent may talk about, such as timings, doctors' days and preparation instructions you have approved. Tell it to pass every clinical question to staff, then test that it does.

- 3 Set outcomes
Assign reschedules, cancellations and patients flagged with a concern to the staff on this list, so a nurse or coordinator can call back.

- 4 Add bookings from new enquiries
Once reminders run cleanly, connect your website and ad forms so new enquiries get a booking call within about a minute.

Be careful with

- Don't let the agent discuss diagnoses, results, medicines or doses. Script it to hand every clinical question to your staff, and check recordings to confirm it does.
- It is not an emergency line. Script it to tell anyone describing an emergency to go to the nearest hospital or call emergency services, and transfer the call to your desk.
- Telleo does not hold HIPAA or other healthcare certifications. Patient calls are sensitive: Patient calls are sensitive, and transcripts can't be restricted by role: give call-log access only to the people who need it, and keep health details out of call fields you do not need., and keep health details out of call fields you do not need.
- If you run separate appointment software, bookings made by the agent reach it only through a webhook or when your front desk enters them.

## Healthcare: common questions
Can the agent answer medical questions? +
It should not, and nothing stops it except your script. Configure it to say the doctor or your staff will answer, and to offer a callback. Every call is transcribed (and recorded, with recording on), so you can check how it handled the question.

Will it work with our hospital management system? +
There is no built-in integration with hospital or lab software. Telleo can send each outcome to any system that accepts a webhook or HTTP request; otherwise your front desk updates bookings from the call log.

Can patients reach the agent by calling us? +
Yes, through the Telleo IVR. An IVR menu option on your Telleo line, for example 'press 2 to book an appointment', can hand the caller to the AI agent.

Which languages can patients use? +
Hindi, English and Hinglish are in production. Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali and other Indian languages are supported by the voice engines and set up with you on request.

Who can see what patients said? +
Transcripts, summaries and captured answers are visible to staff who can open the call log, so keep call-log access to the people who need it. Recordings, when switched on, play there too, and full phone numbers can be restricted by role.

The phone problem

## Where calls slip in lending
01

### Borrowers enquire with several lenders
A loan enquiry is often one of several. The lender that calls first and asks the right questions has the best chance of getting the application.

02

### Applications stall halfway
Applicants start, then stop at document upload or KYC. A reminder call helps, but tele-callers rarely get to every drop-off.

03

### Reminder calls must be courteous and well timed
EMI reminders are sensitive. Tone and hours matter, and every call should be on record in case a borrower complains.

04

### Volume swings with the due-date cycle
Reminder calls bunch up around due dates. Staffing for the peak leaves the team idle the rest of the month.

What Telleo does

## The calls your AI agents make

### Call new loan leads in about a minute
Meta, Google and website leads get a call within about a minute of the form, inside the hours you allow.
Instant lead callback

### Qualify loan enquiries
The agent asks loan type, amount, employment type, income band and city, then rates the lead and assigns the eligible ones to your team.
Lead qualification

### Nudge unfinished applications and KYC
Applicants who stopped at a step are told what is pending and can be sent your link on WhatsApp from an approved template. The agent does not collect or check documents itself.
Application follow-up

### Courteous EMI reminders
A reminder before the due date with the amount and date from your list. If the borrower mentions a problem, script the agent to mark the call for your team rather than press the point.
Payment reminders

### Re-engage dropped leads
When your products or criteria change, call older leads who have consented to be contacted and pass the interested ones to your team.
Lead reactivation

Into your CRM

## Answers worth capturing

- Loan type and amount needed
- Employment type: salaried or self-employed
- Monthly income band
- City or pincode
- Application step where the applicant stopped
- Reason for a delay, in the borrower's words
- Expected payment date, if the borrower offers one
- Request to speak to a person

Day one

## A first rollout

- 1 Start with new-lead qualification
Connect Meta and Google lead forms or your website form, and set the questions that decide eligibility.

- 2 Add application follow-ups
Send drop-offs from your loan system to Telleo by webhook, with the pending step as a field the agent can mention.

- 3 Agree the reminder script with compliance
Have your compliance team sign off the reminder script. Set calling windows, cap retries per borrower, and route every dispute or hardship case to a person.

- 4 Review recordings every week
Every call is transcribed, and recorded with recording on. Sample reminder calls weekly and check the tone against your fair-practices policy.

Be careful with

- Reminder calls must stay courteous. The agent is for reminders, not collections pressure: script it never to threaten, and to send disputes or hardship cases to a person.
- RBI's rules on recovery agents (first issued in circular RBI/2022-23/108 in August 2022, now part of RBI's Responsible Business Conduct Directions) say regulated lenders and their agents must not call borrowers about overdue loans before 8 am or after 7 pm, or call persistently. Set calling windows and retry limits to match, and check current RBI directions with your compliance team.
- The agent does not collect payments or verify KYC documents; script it not to give financial advice. It tells applicants what is pending and sends your link. It tells applicants what is pending and sends your link.
- DLT registration is required for commercial calling in India. Telleo registers it with you.

## Lending: common questions
Can the agent collect EMI payments on the call? +
No. It reminds the borrower of the amount and date, and can send your payment link on WhatsApp from an approved template if the borrower agrees. Payment happens in your own system.

Can it do KYC? +
No. It can tell an applicant which step is pending and send the link to finish it. Checking documents stays with your KYC process.

Can it make collection calls on overdue loans? +
We recommend using it for courteous reminders only, before and just after the due date. Anything beyond a reminder, and every dispute or hardship case, should go to a trained person. RBI's rules on recovery agents (first issued in its August 2022 circular, now part of its Responsible Business Conduct Directions) rule out calls about overdue loans before 8 am or after 7 pm; for microfinance loans the window is 9 am to 6 pm.

How do we control when and how often borrowers are called? +
Campaigns run inside time windows you choose. Workflow calls retry with the gap and maximum attempts you set; a campaign never re-dials on its own, so you decide if and when to re-run it. A daily cap limits total calls, and duplicate protection stops a number being dialled twice by accident.

Is every call recorded? +
Yes, with recording switched on for your calling line, which is the normal setup. Every call is also transcribed, with a summary and a disposition, so you can review how each reminder was handled.

The phone problem

## Where calls slip in e-commerce & d2c
01

### Unwanted COD orders cost you both ways
A COD order that gets refused still costs shipping out and back. A confirmation call before dispatch gives the customer a chance to confirm, change or cancel.

02

### Carts are left for small reasons
A delivery charge, a size question, a payment that failed. A call can answer the question while the customer still wants the product.

03

### Failed deliveries need a quick answer
When a courier marks a delivery as failed, you need to know what happened before the parcel heads back. Calling each customer by hand does not keep up.

What Telleo does

## The calls your AI agents make

### COD order confirmation
Each new COD order gets a call to confirm the product, quantity and a landmark for the address. Confirmed, changed and cancelled orders are sent to your system by webhook.

### Abandoned-checkout callbacks
When your store posts an abandoned checkout to a webhook, the agent calls, asks what stopped the order, and can WhatsApp the checkout link from your approved template.

### Failed-delivery (NDR) calls
The agent asks what happened, checks the customer still wants the parcel, and captures a preferred day and any address correction for your shipping team.

### Post-delivery feedback
A short call after delivery asks for a rating and what could be better. Unhappy customers are assigned to your support team.
Feedback surveys

### Win back past buyers
Call past customers who have consented to hear from you when a product is back in stock or a new range launches, and send interested ones your link on WhatsApp.
Lead reactivation

Into your CRM

## Answers worth capturing

- Order confirmed, changed or cancelled
- Reason for cancelling
- Quantity or variant change requested
- Address landmark or correction
- Preferred re-delivery day (NDR)
- Why the checkout was left
- Feedback rating and comment

Day one

## A first rollout

- 1 Send orders to Telleo by webhook
Send each new COD order to Telleo's webhook as simple fields (phone, items, order value, address), using your order tool or a connector that reshapes the store's own webhook. If your platform cannot send webhooks, a daily CSV import works to start.

- 2 Keep the confirmation call short
Confirm the order, check quantity and variant, ask for a landmark. Set the hours calls may go out.

- 3 Send outcomes back
Add a webhook or HTTP request step so confirmed, changed and cancelled orders reach your order or shipping tool.

- 4 Add NDR and checkout calls
Once COD confirmation runs cleanly, add failed-delivery and abandoned-checkout triggers the same way.

Be careful with

- There is no native Shopify, WooCommerce or courier integration. Orders come in and outcomes go out through webhooks, HTTP requests or CSV.
- The agent does not take payment or edit orders itself, and it cannot look an order up on its own. It reads out the details you send and records what the customer wants; your system or team acts on it.
- Abandoned-checkout and win-back calls are sales calls. Register DLT with us, keep to sensible hours, call past buyers only with their consent, and make 'do not call' a disposition that stops retries, then leave those numbers out of future campaign lists.

## E-commerce & D2C: common questions
Does it integrate with Shopify? +
Not natively. Anything that can send or receive a webhook can connect: your store app or order tool posts new COD orders to Telleo, and Telleo posts the outcome back.

Can the agent cancel or edit the order? +
It captures the change and sends it to your system or team. Whether the order changes automatically depends on what your system does with that webhook.

Can it convert COD orders to prepaid? +
It can offer to send your payment link on WhatsApp from an approved template, and sends it only if the customer agrees. The payment happens on your own checkout.

What if the customer does not pick up? +
Unanswered calls retry with the gap and number of attempts you set. When retries run out, the order can go to a person or be marked unreachable for your team to decide.

Which languages can it use? +
Hindi, English and Hinglish are in production. Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and other regional languages are supported by the voice engines and set up with you on request.

# Telleo vs Telecallers: AI Voice Agent or In-House Team | Telleo
URL: https://telleo.ai/compare/telleo-vs-telecallers/

- Home
- / Compare
- / Telleo vs telecallers
Comparison

# Telleo vs an in-house telecalling team
Many Indian sales and admissions teams already have telecallers. The useful question is not AI or people, but which calls each should make. This page compares an AI voice agent with a human calling team, job by job, so you can split the work sensibly.
The short answer
Use Telleo for the first call to every new lead, reminders, retries and routine qualification, where speed and consistency matter most. Keep your telecallers for negotiation, complex questions and relationships, and let Telleo hand them qualified leads with a call summary. Many teams will want both, working together.

## Side by side
| Telleo | An in-house telecalling team |

Cost basis | Per minute of call. ₹3.49/min on the annual plan (₹19,999/year upfront, no monthly minimum) or ₹3.99/min on monthly plans. Prices exclude 18% GST. | Monthly salary plus incentives, hiring, training and supervision. Salary sites list average telecaller pay at about ₹16,000 to ₹17,500 a month (Indeed India, AmbitionBox). |
Speed to a new lead | Can call a new lead within about 60 seconds of it arriving, through a workflow trigger. | Depends on who is free. Leads that arrive during a busy hour, after office hours or on a holiday wait. |
Coverage | Works through every lead in a campaign, inside the calling windows you choose. | Limited by shifts, leave, breaks and how many people are on the floor that day. |
Scaling up and down | Run a bulk campaign over a list, or call from a workflow. A daily call cap (default 500, configurable) keeps volume in check. | Adding capacity means hiring and training. Reducing it is slow. |
Consistency | Same opening line, same questions and the same outcome list on every call. | Varies by person, experience, mood and time of day. |
Complex conversations | Handles scripted qualification, questions within its brief and bookings. Can transfer the call to a person mid-call. | Better at negotiation, unusual objections, emotional calls and anything that needs judgement. |
Relationships | Not a substitute for a named person the customer knows and trusts. | A person can build trust over many calls and own the account. |
Record keeping | Every AI call transcribed; recording can be switched on for every call. Disposition, summary, lead rating and the caller's answers saved on the call automatically. | Depends on each caller updating the CRM after every call. |
Follow-up | Outcome rules assign, retry or stop. Meetings agreed on the call are booked. WhatsApp or email goes out when the caller said yes. | Manual reminders and callbacks, which are easy to miss when volume is high. |
Quality review | A green, amber or red health verdict on every AI call. Human calls can also be transcribed and scored against your rubric, charged per minute of recording. | Usually a manager listening to a sample of calls. |
Languages | Hindi, English and Hinglish in production. Nine more Indian languages set up with you on request. | Whatever languages your team speaks. |
Best for | First calls, reminders, re-engagement of leads who have consented, and qualification at volume. | Closing, negotiation, escalations and key accounts. |

## Choose Telleo if…

- New leads wait hours for a first call because your team is busy.
- A big part of your team's day goes on unanswered calls, retries and reminders.
- You want every call transcribed, summarised and logged without relying on manual notes.
- Your lead volume rises and falls, and you don't want to hire for the peak.
- The people you call speak Hindi, English or Hinglish.

## Choose an in-house telecalling team if…

- Your sale needs negotiation, custom pricing or long consultative conversations.
- Customers expect a named relationship manager who knows their history.
- Calls involve sensitive or emotional situations that need human judgement.
- The people you call mainly speak a language Telleo does not yet run in production.
- Your call volume is small enough for one person to handle comfortably.

## Where a telecaller's time goes
Much of a telecaller's day is not conversation. It is dialling, waiting on numbers that do not pick up, redialling later and typing notes afterwards.
Telleo takes that routine layer. It dials, retries unanswered workflow calls with a gap and a maximum number of attempts, and writes the outcome to the lead. Your team picks up where a real conversation is needed.

## Speed to lead
Research reported in Harvard Business Review in 2011, covering 1.25 million leads at 42 US companies, found that firms which tried to contact a web lead within an hour were nearly 7 times as likely to qualify it as those that tried an hour later, and more than 60 times as likely as those that waited 24 hours or longer. In a separate audit of 2,241 U.S. companies, the same authors found that among companies that responded within 30 days, the average response time was 42 hours.
Telleo can call a new lead within about 60 seconds of it arriving from a Meta lead ad, a Google lead form or a website form. If the lead is interested, outcome rules assign it to a rep along with the call summary.

## What each costs
Salary sites give a rough guide. Indeed India lists an average of ₹16,310 a month for a caller, based on 1.9k salaries from job postings (updated 3 July 2026). AmbitionBox lists ₹2.1 lakh a year, about ₹17.5k a month, for a telecaller, based on 23.8k salaries. Pay varies by city, experience and company, and the full cost of a seat also includes incentives, hiring, training and supervision.
Telleo is priced per minute of call. On the annual plan you pay ₹19,999 a year upfront and ₹3.49 a minute from the first minute, with no monthly minimum. Prices exclude 18% GST, and DLT/PE registration is ₹5,900 a year at actuals. It is not a like-for-like swap: an AI agent does not replace a good telecaller's judgement, but it can take the calls that do not need it.

## How the two work together
Telleo is built to sit next to a human team. Outcome rules assign a lead to a counsellor or sales rep on the outcomes you pick, workflow calls skip leads already assigned to a rep, and a live transfer can bring a person into the call.
Your team can keep using Airtel IQ or Exotel for click-to-call. Those calls, or recordings uploaded from anywhere, can be transcribed in Hindi, English or Hinglish and scored against your rubric, with coaching tips and a rep leaderboard.

See it on your own calls
A 20-minute demo on your script. Compare for yourself.

## Questions
Will Telleo replace my telecallers? +
It is not designed to. Telleo takes first calls, retries, reminders and routine qualification, and passes interested leads to your team with a summary. Negotiation, closing and relationships stay with people.

Can a caller speak to a person during an AI call? +
Yes. Each agent can have handoff numbers. The agent says a short bridge line, then connects the call to a person on your team.

How do I know what the AI agent said on a call? +
Every AI call has a full transcript, and recording can be switched on for every call. You also get an outcome from your own list, a two to three sentence summary, a lead rating from 1 to 10 and the answers the caller actually gave.

Can Telleo review my human team's calls too? +
Yes. Click-to-call calls on Plivo, Exotel or Airtel, or recordings you upload, can be transcribed and scored against your rubric, with objections, next best action and coaching tips. This is charged per minute of recording. Analysis of AI calls is free.

Where do the salary figures come from? +
Indeed India (an average of ₹16,310 a month for a caller, updated 3 July 2026) and AmbitionBox (an average of ₹2.1 lakh a year for a telecaller). We read both on 25 September 2026. Actual pay varies widely by city, experience and company.

Which languages can the AI agent speak? +
Hindi, English and Hinglish are in production. Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi and Odia are supported by the voice engines and set up with you on request.
